abstract: Libraries and archives manage large collections with limited staff and computing budgets, yet common benchmarks do not systematically test their bibliographic work. They need to know which methods work for their tasks and what those methods require to run. SHELF, the Synthetic Harness for Evaluating LLM Fitness, addresses this gap. It is a Python system that turns labelled taxonomies, writing specifications, and a generation budget into controlled benchmark data and evaluation tasks. This first release contains 62,899 model-written documents based on Library of Congress vocabularies, with tasks for classification, clustering, retrieval, pair classification, and instruction retrieval. We compare TF, TF-IDF, BM25, popular encoders, and, on subject classification only, zero-shot decoders; each method appears only on tasks that support it. Subject classification reaches 0.8887, while genre-form classification reaches only 0.2605, and several pair and clustering tasks remain near chance. Sparse methods remain competitive on classification, while TF-IDF is the fastest measured arm in the subject timing experiment. SHELF also varies bibliographic facets independently and can generate new, verifiably unseen documents after a model's training cutoff. Comparisons with LCSHBench and Project Gutenberg show that model rankings transfer more reliably than absolute scores, but SHELF scores do not estimate accuracy on production catalogue data. We release all source code and data under permissive licenses on GitHub and Hugging Face.
summary_zh: 图书馆和档案馆在人员与计算预算有限的条件下管理海量馆藏，而现有通用基准无法对其文献工作进行系统性测试。相关从业者需要明确哪些方法可适配自身任务，以及这些方法的运行要求。SHELF全称为Synthetic Harness for Evaluating LLM Fitness，是为填补该空白而开发的Python系统，可将带标签的分类体系、编写规范和生成预算转化为受控基准数据和评估任务。本版本发布的数据集包含62899份基于美国国会图书馆词汇库生成的模型撰写文档，覆盖分类、聚类、检索、配对分类和指令检索任务。研究对TF、TF-IDF、BM25、主流编码器模型，以及仅在主题分类任务上测试的零样本解码器模型进行了对比，所有方法仅在其支持的任务上运行。实验结果显示，主题分类任务准确率可达0.8887，而体裁形式分类任务准确率仅为0.2605，多个配对和聚类任务的性能接近随机水平。稀疏方法在分类任务上仍具备竞争力，其中TF-IDF是主题计时实验中速度最快的方法。SHELF可独立调整文献的不同维度，还可生成模型训练截止日期后生成的、可验证为未见过的新文档。与LCSHBench和Project Gutenberg的对比表明，模型排名的可迁移性远高于绝对分数，但SHELF的分数无法直接用于估计生产目录数据上的准确率。所有源代码和数据均已在GitHub和Hugging Face上以宽松许可证发布。

title: ObserverBench: Testing Mechanistic Estimates for Intervention and Control
title_zh: ObserverBench：面向干预与控制的机制估计测试基准
authors: Vijay Erramilli
abstract: Mechanistic interpretability is increasingly used to guide interventions such as activation steering, circuit removal, and safety monitoring. Yet an internal estimate that is accurate on average can still choose a poor action.We present ObserverBench, a benchmark framework for testing whether an internal estimator---an observer---is adequate for the intervention, control, or safety task it directs. Each task fixes the model, information boundary, allowed actions, decision rule, held-out cases, and loss. The benchmark reports estimation accuracy separately from the loss caused by the chosen action.Theory and experiments show why both are needed. In closed-loop control, observer errors matter at the starting point and along directions the allowed intervention can reach. On circuit-intervention tasks in GPT-2-small and Qwen2.5-7B, pairwise observers predict unseen effects more accurately without always choosing better actions; observers trained on action loss choose lower-loss actions. In safety triage, a score that perfectly separates violations can allocate a fixed intervention budget poorly when violations have different costs. Across Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B-it, and prospectively frozen Qwen3.5-9B APPS tasks, AUROC can rank monitors differently from deployment loss, and the best information source changes across models. Sparse SAE readouts also trail their layer-matched dense controls on the reported Qwen panels, under disclosed activation-density or checkpoint mismatches.ObserverBench provides fixed task contracts, runnable baselines, and table-based submissions for evaluating interpretability methods through the actions they enable.
summary_zh: 机制可解释性正被越来越多地用于指导激活 steering、电路移除和安全监测等干预操作。然而，即便平均精度表现优异的内部估计器，仍有可能选择出效果很差的动作。本文提出ObserverBench，一个用于测试内部估计器（即观测器）是否足以支撑其面向的干预、控制或安全任务的基准框架。每个任务固定模型、信息边界、允许执行的动作、决策规则、留出案例和损失函数，基准会分别报告估计精度和所选动作带来的实际损失。理论和实验证明了同时评估二者的必要性：在闭环控制场景下，观测器的误差在起点处以及允许干预可到达的方向上都会产生影响。在GPT-2-small和Qwen2.5-7B的电路干预任务上，成对观测器预测未见过的效应的精度更高，但并不总能选择出更优的动作；基于动作损失训练的观测器可选择出损失更低的动作。在安全分类任务中，即便可完美区分违规行为的评分，当不同违规行为的代价存在差异时，也可能无法合理分配固定的干预预算。在Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma-2-9B-it和冻结版Qwen3.5-9B的APPS任务上，AUROC指标对监测器的排名结果与实际部署损失的排名结果存在差异，且不同模型对应的最优信息源并不相同。在公开的激活密度或检查点不匹配的条件下，稀疏稀疏自编码器（Sparse SAE）读出结果在所有Qwen测试面板上的性能均低于对应层的密集对照方法。ObserverBench提供了固定的任务约束、可运行的基线和基于表格的提交流程，可通过可解释性方法实际支持的动作效果对其进行评估。

title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: 蒸馏前先验证：面向策略内蒸馏的提示层级教师门控机制
authors: Zhiwei Zhang, Zechen Sun, Fei Zhao, Kang Peng, Bin Liang 等 (9 人)
abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) accelerates post-training by providing dense token-level supervision from a frozen teacher on the student's own rollouts. Vanilla OPD applies this supervision uniformly across prompts, without checking whether the teacher is reliable for each prompt. Because reverse KL is mode-seeking, a confidently wrong teacher can induce a strong yet misleading update. Distributional proxies, such as entropy or teacher-student likelihood agreement, measure uncertainty or agreement but do not directly verify outcome correctness. We introduce Teacher-Gated On-Policy Distillation (TGOPD), built on the principle that teacher reliability should be verified at the prompt level before dense supervision is admitted. TGOPD estimates reliability from a small set of verifier-scored teacher probes and routes each prompt exclusively to dense OPD when the reliability check passes or to verifier-grounded GRPO otherwise. Across 4B and 35B students in mathematics, code, and instruction following, TGOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD in all six single-domain settings and achieves higher seven-benchmark averages at both scales under multi-domain training. By using otherwise-idle teacher capacity for reliability estimation, TGOPD also reduces teacher-side compute waste in asynchronous OPD, increasing teacher-node GPU utilization from 9.8% to 78.9% in the measured 4B single-domain run.
summary_zh: 策略内蒸馏（On-policy distillation, OPD）基于冻结教师模型在学生模型自身 rollout 样本上输出的稠密 token 级监督信号，可加速训练后阶段的收敛速度。基础版策略内蒸馏对所有提示统一施加该监督信号，不会逐一校验教师模型在对应提示上的可靠性。由于反向KL散度具备模式搜寻特性，过度自信的错误教师模型会生成误导性极强的更新方向。熵、师生似然一致性等分布代理指标可衡量不确定性或师生输出一致性，但无法直接验证输出结果的正确性。本文提出教师门控策略内蒸馏（Teacher-Gated On-Policy Distillation, TGOPD），核心原则是在引入稠密监督前，需在提示层级完成教师模型的可靠性校验。TGOPD基于少量经校验器打分的教师探测样本估计可靠性，仅当可靠性校验通过时，才将对应提示路由至稠密OPD流程，否则将其路由至基于校验器的GRPO流程。在数学、代码、指令遵循三类任务的4B和35B参数量学生模型上开展的实验表明，TGOPD在全部6个单域设置下的表现均优于基础版OPD，且在多域训练场景下两个参数量规模的7项基准测试平均表现更高。TGOPD将原本闲置的教师算力用于可靠性估计，还可降低异步OPD场景下教师侧的计算资源浪费，在实测的4B单域运行实验中，教师节点GPU利用率从9.8%提升至78.9%。

title: Evaluating Graph Neural Networks for Change-Criticality Classification in Maritime Navigation Charts
title_zh: 面向海事导航图中变更关键度分类的图神经网络评估研究
authors: Abhishek Potnis, Jacob Arndt
abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a class of neural networks suitable for learning on graph-structured data. Their application to spatial data is a natural extension, however its relatively unclear which message-passing operations, architectural configurations, and graph representation is best suited for classifying changes to objects in electronic navigational charts (ENCs)--geospatial vector datasets used for marine navigation. Maintaining these datasets is a challenge, and categorizing changes to objects in the ENC based on their significance to navigational safety is of particular importance. Here, we propose to represent these vector navigation datasets as a graph structure where the spatial objects serve as nodes and their spatial and semantic relationships form edges. We encode both the old ENC dataset and new ENC dataset into a pair of graphs and frame the task as a graph-pair classification problem. Building on this representation, we investigate the use of GNN architectures to classify whether the encoded graphs constitutes a critical or non-critical risk to navigational safety. We train and evaluate several GNN architectures and model configurations on ENC changes reviewed by maritime experts. Our results demonstrate that graph-based representations improve the classification of ENC updates, providing a scalable approach for automating or improving ENC maintenance workflows.
summary_zh: 图神经网络（Graph neural networks, GNNs）是一类适用于图结构数据学习的神经网络。将其应用于空间数据是自然的延伸方向，但目前学界仍不明确何种消息传递操作、架构配置与图表示形式最适合对电子导航图（Electronic navigational charts, ENCs）——海事导航所用的地理空间矢量数据集——内的对象变更进行分类。维护这类数据集存在诸多挑战，基于变更对航行安全的影响程度对ENC内的对象变更进行分类尤为重要。本文提出将这类矢量导航数据集表示为图结构：以空间对象为节点，对象间的空间与语义关系为边。本文将旧版ENC数据集与新版ENC数据集均编码为图对，将该任务建模为图对分类问题。基于该表示形式，本文探究使用不同GNN架构判断编码后的图对是否会对航行安全构成关键或非关键风险。本文基于海事专家审核过的ENC变更样本，训练并评估了多种GNN架构与模型配置。实验结果表明，基于图的表示方法可提升ENC更新分类的效果，为自动化优化ENC维护工作流提供了可扩展的实现路径。

title: Toward Collective-Centric Evaluation of Preference Inference for Participatory Democracy
title_zh: 面向参与式民主的偏好推理集体中心型评估框架研究
authors: Pierre-Antoine Lequeu, Salim Hafid, Paul Lerner, Nazanin Shafiabadi, Laurène Cave 等 (9 人)
abstract: To scale up collective decision-making, participatory democracy platforms such as Polis and Remesh enable online deliberation among thousands of participants. However, at this scale, participants cannot review every opinion submitted by others, producing highly sparse voting data that misrepresent patterns of consensus, conflict, and minority support. Platforms therefore increasingly rely on Preference Inference (PI) models to predict missing votes. Yet this automation is not neutral: inferred preferences can artificially amplify, suppress, or reorder existing patterns of support, ultimately reshaping how the outcomes of a deliberation are interpreted. More generally, we lack a systematic understanding of how existing PI methods affect the collective preference landscape. To address this gap, we benchmark several existing PI approaches in this context. Moving beyond conventional user-centric evaluations centered on the accuracy of individual predictions, we introduce a collective-centric evaluation framework that measures whether inferred votes preserve salient properties of the broader preference landscape. We further contribute the largest multilingual dataset of its kind: four consultations spanning over 90k participants, 1M votes, and 22 languages. Our experiments show that models with comparable predictive accuracy can differ substantially in the degree to which they preserve the collective structure. These results demonstrate that accuracy alone is insufficient for evaluating \emph{PI} in democratic settings. By contributing a novel comprehensive and collective-centric evaluation benchmark for the task of PI, this work aims to support the development of AI systems that scale deliberation without compromising the integrity of its democratic outcomes.
summary_zh: 为扩大集体决策规模，Polis、Remesh等参与式民主平台支持数千名参与者在线开展协商讨论。但在该规模下，参与者无法逐一查看其他用户提交的所有意见，最终生成的投票数据高度稀疏，无法准确反映共识、冲突与少数群体支持的真实分布模式。因此这类平台越来越依赖偏好推理（Preference Inference, PI）模型预测缺失的投票，但这类自动化流程并非价值中立：推断得到的偏好可能人为放大、抑制或重排现有支持模式，最终改变协商结果的解读方式。更广泛地说，目前学界尚未系统性理解现有PI方法对集体偏好分布的影响。为填补这一研究空白，本文在该场景下对多种现有PI方法开展基准测试。本文突破传统以个体预测准确率为核心的用户中心型评估范式，提出集体中心型评估框架，用于衡量推断得到的投票是否保留了更广泛偏好分布的核心属性。本文还贡献了同类研究中规模最大的多语言数据集：覆盖4场协商活动、9万余名参与者、100万条投票记录与22种语言。实验结果表明，预测准确率相近的模型在保留集体结构的程度上存在显著差异，该结果证明仅靠准确率不足以评估民主场景下的PI模型效果。本文提出的面向PI任务的全新综合性集体中心型评估基准，可为开发能够扩大协商规模、同时不损害民主结果公正性的AI系统提供支撑。

title: Structure and Implementation of New Practical English Textbooks Driven by Artificial Intelligence
title_zh: 人工智能驱动的新型实用英语教材的结构与实现
authors: Ya Wang, Lei Zhang, Xueguang Yang, Bo Chen
abstract: Artificial intelligence is changing the form of applied English materials from fixed paper sequences to adaptive learning systems that can diagnose learners, recommend tasks, and provide formative feedback. This paper studies the structure and application of a new practical English textbook driven by artificial intelligence. A five-layer architecture is proposed: knowledge mapping, learner profiling, task generation, feedback orchestration, and teacher-side governance. A prototype was tested on 186 non-English-major undergraduates for eight weeks of teaching. Compared with a static digital textbook, the proposed system increased the unit completion accuracy from 72.4% to 84.9%, raised the average score for speaking tasks by 10.8 points, and reduced the teacher's correction time by 31.6%. Therefore, an AI-driven textbook can maintain the stability of the curriculum while providing personalised learning paths, rich practice materials and traceable classroom data.
summary_zh: 人工智能正在改变应用英语教材的形态，使其从固定的纸质内容序列转变为可诊断学习者状态、推荐学习任务、提供形成性反馈的自适应学习系统。本文研究了人工智能驱动的新型实用英语教材的结构与应用模式，提出了五层架构：知识图谱层、学习者画像层、任务生成层、反馈编排层与教师侧治理层。研究团队面向186名非英语专业本科生开展了为期8周的教学原型测试，结果显示：与静态数字教材相比，本文提出的系统将单元完成准确率从72.4%提升至84.9%，口语任务平均得分提升10.8分，教师批改时长降低31.6%。由此可见，AI驱动的教材可在保障课程体系稳定性的同时，为学习者提供个性化学习路径、丰富练习材料与可追溯的课堂数据。

title: Privacy-Preserving Topology-Guided Safety for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems via Federated Graph Learning
title_zh: 基于联邦图学习的大语言模型多智能体系统隐私保护拓扑引导安全机制
authors: Jinxi Yu, Eric Hanchen Jiang, Levina Li, Dong Liu, Zhi Zhang 等 (9 人)
abstract: Topology-guided safeguards for LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) train a GNN over the inter-agent communication graph to localize risky agents and intervene on the topology---but they assume one operator can pool all labeled traces. Across organizations that assumption breaks: episodes contain private prompts, tool outputs, and proprietary workflows, and no silo alone sees the full attack distribution. We cast privacy-preserving MAS safeguarding as graph federated learning and instantiate FGLGuard: each operator fits an edge-featured graph attention detector on its own judge-labeled episode graphs and shares only model updates. The method couples a proximal local objective for non-IID clients, domain-balanced aggregation, over-refusal-constrained threshold calibration, corroborated upstream scoring, and a guarded rewrite for blocked answers. Federation is not optional: off-the-shelf transfer collapses under distribution shift (AUROC 0.51 to 0.70 only after in-domain retraining), so a deployable guard must adapt on each site's private traces. On Agent-SafetyBench, R-Judge, and AgentDojo, federated FGLGuard exceeds the in-domain centralized ceiling on all three benchmarks without pooling any data---where unsupervised anomaly guards and local-only training fail. One guard federated across four different-domain operators comes within 0.03 AUROC of multi-domain centralization, while any single-domain guard collapses on the others. Live FGLGuard cuts AgentDojo's ground-truth attack-success rate by 43% at near-unguarded utility, zero API cost, and negligible capability loss.
summary_zh: 面向大语言模型驱动多智能体系统（LLM-based multi-agent systems, MAS）的拓扑引导安全机制，通过在智能体间通信图上训练GNN定位风险智能体、对拓扑结构实施干预，但这类机制默认单一运营方可汇集所有带标注的轨迹数据，该假设在跨组织场景下无法成立：交互片段包含私有提示、工具输出与专有工作流，任意数据孤岛都无法观测完整的攻击分布。本文将隐私保护型MAS安全防护问题建模为图联邦学习任务，实现了FGLGuard框架：每个运营方基于自身经裁判标注的交互片段图训练边特征图注意力检测器，仅共享模型更新参数。该方法融合了面向非独立同分布客户端的近端局部目标、域平衡聚合机制、避免过度拒绝的约束阈值校准、交叉验证上游打分机制，以及针对拦截回答的安全重写模块。联邦机制是该场景下的必要选择：开箱即用的迁移学习方法在分布偏移场景下性能会大幅衰减（仅在域内重训练后AUROC才能从0.51提升至0.70），因此可部署的安全防护机制必须适配每个站点的私有轨迹数据。在Agent-SafetyBench、R-Judge与AgentDojo三个测试集上，无需汇集任何原始数据的联邦FGLGuard性能超过了域内中心化训练的上限，而无监督异常防护机制与仅本地训练的方案均无法达到该效果。跨4个不同域运营方训练得到的统一防护模型，AUROC仅比多域中心化训练结果低0.03，而任意单域训练的防护模型在其他域上性能完全失效。实际部署的FGLGuard可在几乎不损失系统效用、零额外API调用成本、能力损耗可忽略的前提下，将AgentDojo上的真实攻击成功率降低43%。

title: When Optimization Becomes Manipulation: Defending Generative Search against Malicious Generative Engine Optimization
authors: Haozhang Li, Yangguang Shao, Xinjie Lin, Zhong Guan, Mi Zhou 等 (6 人)
abstract: This paper focuses on defending generative search engines against malicious Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), which rewrites web documents to match engines' citation preferences and thereby manipulates generated answers. Recent GEO methods have advanced from hand-crafted rewriting to automated and agentic optimization, substantially increasing the visibility of target documents in generated answers. However, defending against such manipulation poses two major challenges: attack documents remain factually consistent with their originals, rendering fact verification and perplexity filtering ineffective, and the features they amplify equally characterize high-quality benign content. To address these limitations, we propose GEO Defender, a two-stage defense aligned with the attack chain that requires no fine-tuning of the target LLM. GEO Defender consists of Shield Reranker and Training-Free Shield Generation (TFSG). Specifically, Shield Reranker learns a preference-based defensive residual over a frozen base reranker, demoting GEO-rewritten documents while preserving relevance judgments, and TFSG distills defense outcomes into a natural-language experience library that guides the target LLM's source use at inference. Experiments on two state-of-the-art closed-source LLMs and three open-source LLMs across seven GEO attacks demonstrate that GEO Defender reduces the average attack success rate from 50.32% to 6.20%, retains 94.12% of benign-evidence use, preserves answer quality, and generalizes to unseen attacks from construction instances.

title: The Geometry of Ignorance: LLMs Know When to Temper Bayesian Priors
title_zh: 无知的几何：大语言模型知晓何时调整贝叶斯先验强度
authors: Toni J.B. Liu, Jiajun Bao, Yizhou Liu, Gurbir Arora, Nicolas Boullé 等 (7 人)
abstract: What does a language model predict when it has few clues? The answer lurks in its unembedding geometry: a single direction of the unembedding matrix encodes the unigram distribution of the training corpus, which serves as the Bayesian prior the model falls back on when uncertain. This structure --- which we term the \emph{direction of ignorance} --- appears in all four model families examined (\texttt{Llama}, \texttt{Qwen}, \texttt{Gemma}, and \texttt{Pythia}), ranging from 0.4B to 405B parameters. Projecting the final prediction state onto this direction yields a per-token \emph{prior loading factor} $\lambda$, which, empirically, declines steadily as the context becomes more informative. Formally, the same projection decomposes the prediction state into two orthogonal vectors that correspond exactly to the two factors of a tempered Bayesian update: a unigram prior raised to the exponent $\lambda$ and a context-driven likelihood. This geometric-probabilistic interpretation calibrates $\lambda$, making it meaningfully comparable across model sizes and families, with larger models generally exhibiting lower prior reliance in the high-context limit. Finally, we show that the direction of ignorance is causally active: raising or lowering $\lambda$ at the final prediction state steers the prediction toward or away from the unigram prior in KL divergence.
summary_zh: 当语言模型仅掌握极少线索时会做出何种预测？答案隐藏在其解嵌入几何结构中：解嵌入矩阵的某一特定方向编码了训练语料的一元分布，该分布是模型处于不确定状态时会回退使用的贝叶斯先验。本文将该结构命名为「无知方向」，在测试的Llama、Qwen、Gemma、Pythia共4个参数量从0.4B到405B的模型家族中均观测到该结构。将最终预测状态投影到该方向可得到逐token的「先验加载因子」λ，实证结果显示随着上下文信息丰富度提升，λ会稳步下降。从形式化角度来看，该投影可将预测状态分解为两个正交向量，恰好对应调整型贝叶斯更新的两个组成部分：指数为λ的一元先验，以及由上下文驱动的似然项。该几何-概率层面的解释可实现λ的校准，使得不同参数量、不同家族模型的λ具备可比性，通常参数量更大的模型在高上下文场景下对先验的依赖程度更低。最后本文验证了无知方向的因果活性：在最终预测状态上调高或调低λ，可通过KL散度将预测结果引导至一元先验方向或远离一元先验方向。

title: PrivateHub: Contrastive Diffusion Model for Private Sensor-Intensive Environment Data Generation
title_zh: PrivateHub：面向隐私敏感密集传感器环境数据生成的对比扩散模型
authors: Jiechao Gao, Yuandong Pan, Jie Wang, Michael Lepech, Bradford Campbell
abstract: Sensor-intensive environments enable many intelligent services by inferring user applications from heterogeneous data streams. However, not all applications should be exposed: users want some activities to stay private. This creates a tension between inferring applications for useful services and preventing unwanted inference. Existing approaches such as differential privacy and rule-based filtering protect individual streams but cannot address the privacy risk from cross-sensor inference.We introduce Privatehub, which uses contrastive learning within a diffusion model to generate synthetic multi-sensor streams that keep non-private applications detectable while concealing private ones. Privatehub has two stages: App-Conditioned Pre-training (ACP), which conditions the model on multi-sensor data with application embeddings, and App-Aware Fine-tuning (AAF), which separates private from non-private data via contrastive learning. We also define a threat model for the multi-sensor sharing setting. Experiments on three real-world multi-sensor datasets show Privatehub lowers private-application accuracy by 40 to 50\% without hurting non-private performance, and stays robust when the attacker retrains on the synthetic data.
summary_zh: 密集传感器环境可通过从异构数据流中推断用户应用状态支撑大量智能服务，但并非所有用户活动都应当被暴露：用户希望部分活动保持隐私状态，这就产生了支撑有用服务的应用推断需求与防范非授权推断的隐私保护需求之间的矛盾。现有差分隐私、基于规则过滤等方法仅能保护单条数据流，无法防范跨传感器推断带来的隐私风险。本文提出PrivateHub框架，在扩散模型内部引入对比学习，生成合成多传感器数据流，在隐藏用户隐私活动的同时保障非隐私活动仍可被正常检测。PrivateHub包含两个阶段：应用条件预训练（App-Conditioned Pre-training, ACP），基于带应用嵌入的多传感器数据为模型施加条件约束；应用感知微调（App-Aware Fine-tuning, AAF），通过对比学习区分隐私数据与非隐私数据。本文还针对多传感器数据共享场景定义了对应的威胁模型。在3个真实多传感器数据集上开展的实验表明，PrivateHub可将隐私活动的推断准确率降低40%~50%，同时不损害非隐私活动的检测性能，即便攻击者基于合成数据重新训练推断模型，该框架仍可保持防护鲁棒性。

title: Privacy-Preserving Heterogeneous Multi-LLM Federated Inference for Cognitive Diagnosis
title_zh: 面向认知诊断的隐私保护异构多大语言模型联邦推理框架
authors: Yagna Manasa Boyapati, Chong Yu, Tianyu Jiang, Justin Zhan
abstract: Significant challenges remain in AI-driven educational systems in balancing privacy preservation with accurate cognitive diagnosis. To overcome this, we propose a federated inference framework in which several commercial LLM APIs collaborate without requiring access to raw student data or proprietary model internals. Using multiple federated entities, such as LLaMA-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, and Claude-3-Haiku, our framework builds upon a heterogeneous multi-LLM architecture. The predictions generated by these entities are combined with epsilon-local differential privacy by adding Laplace noise locally to each entity's prediction output before aggregation, while residual-based aggregation mitigates model heterogeneity. Our approach is predicated on an honest-but-curious trust paradigm in which API providers are presumed not to abuse submitted queries, and our differential privacy mechanism shields the published diagnostic results from external inference. We conduct rigorous privacy-utility analysis showing strong privacy guarantees with minimal accuracy loss, and extensive real-world evaluations across three educational benchmarks confirm the framework's practical usability and cross-domain generalizability.
summary_zh: AI驱动的教育系统在平衡隐私保护需求与高精度认知诊断目标方面仍面临诸多挑战。为解决该问题，本文提出联邦推理框架，多个商用大语言模型API可在无需访问原始学生数据、无需获取专有模型内部参数的前提下开展协作。本文框架基于异构多大语言模型架构，接入LLaMA-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3-Haiku等多个联邦参与方。各参与方生成的预测结果融合了ε局部差分隐私机制：在聚合前向每个参与方的预测输出中局部添加拉普拉斯噪声，同时基于残差的聚合机制缓解模型异构性带来的性能损失。本文框架基于诚实但好奇的信任范式，假设API服务提供商不会滥用提交的查询，差分隐私机制可保护最终输出的诊断结果不被外部推断反推原始数据。本文开展了严格的隐私-效用分析，证明该框架可在精度损失极小的前提下提供强隐私保障，在3个教育基准测试集上的大量真实场景评估验证了该框架的实用价值与跨域泛化能力。

title: Reflect-SQL: A Self-Reflection Based Framework for Text-to-SQL
title_zh: Reflect-SQL：基于自反思的Text-to-SQL框架
authors: Anupreksha Jain, Manish Shrivastava
abstract: Democratizing data access through natural language is a crucial goal for modern enterprises, but the practical adoption of Text-to-SQL is critically hindered by real-world complexities: 1. Obscure and large database schemas, 2. Ineffective retrieval of relevant tables and columns due to structured setting of schemas and vague user query, 3. Generation of syntactically or logically flawed SQL due to a lack of robust validation and correction mechanism. To address these systemic challenges, we introduce Reflect-SQL, a novel framework for Text to SQL, grounded in multi-stage self-reflection approach to develop understanding of obscure schema using a knowledge base, setup a process for effective retrieval and system to generate syntactically/semantically SQL. Instead of a single-pass attempt, our system employs an LLM-as-a-judge driven scoring mechanism within interconnected feedback loops to iteratively refine the results at every stage. A feedback-driven retrieval loop refines the user's natural language query, while a synthesis loop validates and corrects the SQL and finally, an entailment loop optimizes the end-to-end process and continuously enriches the knowledge base. By integrating these layers of reflection, Reflect-SQL bridges the critical gap between user intent and complex data. On the challenging BIRD benchmark, our framework achieves an execution accuracy of 72.03%, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating a major leap in reliability for enterprise applications.
summary_zh: 通过自然语言实现数据访问普惠化是现代企业的核心目标之一，但Text-to-SQL技术的实际落地受到诸多现实复杂因素的严重制约：1. 数据库 schema 晦涩且规模庞大；2. 受schema的结构化特性与用户查询表述模糊的影响，相关表与列的检索效果不佳；3. 由于缺乏鲁棒的校验纠错机制，生成的SQL存在语法或逻辑缺陷。为系统性解决上述挑战，本文提出全新的Text-to-SQL框架Reflect-SQL，基于多阶段自反思方法，依托知识库建立对晦涩schema的深度理解，搭建高效检索流程，生成语法与语义均正确的SQL。该框架摒弃单次生成模式，在互联的反馈回路中引入大模型即裁判的打分机制，在每个阶段迭代优化输出结果：反馈驱动的检索回路优化用户的自然语言查询，合成回路校验并修正SQL，蕴含回路优化端到端流程并持续丰富知识库。通过整合多层自反思机制，Reflect-SQL打通了用户意图与复杂数据之间的关键链路。在难度较高的BIRD基准测试集上，该框架的执行准确率达到72.03%，大幅超越现有最优基线模型，证明其在企业级应用场景下的可靠性实现了显著跃升。

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge: Concerning Rubric Artifacts in LLM-based Automated Text Generation Evaluation
title_zh: 评判LLM-as-a-Judge（大语言模型作为评判者）：基于大语言模型的自动文本生成评估中的评分标准伪影问题
authors: Anshul Bagaria, Sowmya S Sundaram, Gokul S Krishnan, Balaraman Ravindran
abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines are increasingly used to evaluate AI-generated text, based on the assumption that judgments arise from reasoning over candidate responses with respect to a rubric. We show that this assumption warrants further scrutiny. Classifiers trained only on rubric text, without access to any evaluated response, achieve nontrivial predictive performance on judge outputs. This suggests that rubric formulations encode recoverable evaluative signals, allowing scores to be partially anticipated independently of model outputs. Finally, counterfactual perturbations reveal that judges often fail to reliably update their decisions when either the candidate response or the rubric criterion is reversed. Our findings raise concerns about the reliability of rubric-based LLM evaluation and highlight the need for further methodological study of automated evaluation via LLMs.
summary_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge流水线目前被越来越多地用于评估AI生成文本，其核心假设是评判结果是评判者对照评分标准对待评估候选回复进行推理后得到的。本研究表明该假设有待进一步审视：仅在评分标准文本上训练、完全不接触任何待评估回复的分类器，就可以对评判者的输出实现可观的预测性能。这说明评分标准的表述中编码了可被提取的评估信号，使得最终评分可以在一定程度上脱离模型输出被预判。最后，反事实扰动实验显示，当候选回复或评分标准准则被反转时，评判者往往无法可靠地更新其决策。本研究结果对基于评分标准的大语言模型评估的可靠性提出了担忧，凸显了针对大语言模型自动评估开展进一步方法学研究的必要性。

title: Listen to the Latents: Self-Correcting Speech Recognition in Large Audio Language Models Through Hidden-State Interactions
title_zh: 潜层信号监听：大音频语言模型中基于隐状态交互的自校正语音识别
authors: Chan-Jan Hsu, Jaeyeon Kim, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Shinji Watanabe, Hung-yi Lee 等 (6 人)
abstract: Recent automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems increasingly integrate large language models (LLMs) to leverage their semantic knowledge, either externally through logit fusion or internally through warm initialization. However, how to effectively combine these two strategies remains underexplored. In this work, we refine warm-initialized LLM-based ASR models by leveraging their own pre-adaptation base LLMs, focusing on LoRA-adapted settings where the base LLM is preserved. To achieve this, we propose Hybrid Search, a targeted correction strategy motivated by two observations. First, interaction features that characterize the relationship between LLM-based ASR hidden states and base-LLM hidden states provide informative signals about a token's degree of semantic dependence. Second, selectively refining targeted tokens with high semantic dependence improves ASR performance far beyond naive global LLM-correction methods including rescoring and late fusion. Our analysis suggests that, even after semantic knowledge transfer through warm initialization, LLM-based ASR models can still leverage their base LLM to further improve inference-time performance.
summary_zh: 当前自动语音识别（ASR）系统越来越多地集成大语言模型（LLM）以利用其语义知识，集成方式分为通过对数似然融合的外部集成，以及通过热初始化的内部集成两类。然而，如何有效结合这两种策略目前仍缺乏充分探索。本研究针对保留基础大语言模型的LoRA（低秩适配）场景，通过利用预适配阶段的基础大语言模型，对基于热初始化的大语言模型ASR模型进行优化。为实现该目标，本文提出Hybrid Search（混合搜索）这一针对性校正策略，该策略基于两项核心观察提出：第一，表征大语言模型ASR隐状态与基础大语言模型隐状态之间关联的交互特征，能够提供关于token语义依赖程度的高信息量信号；第二，针对高语义依赖的目标token进行选择性优化，所带来的ASR性能提升远优于重打分、后期融合等朴素全局大模型校正方法。分析结果表明，即使已经通过热初始化完成语义知识迁移，基于大语言模型的ASR模型仍然可以借助其基础大语言模型进一步提升推理阶段的性能。

title: Counterexamples as Feedback for Agent Self-Correction
title_zh: 作为智能体自校正反馈的反例
authors: Sidhesh Badrinarayan, Adithya Parthasarathy
abstract: Single-turn code-generation metrics understate a central property of deployed agents: whether they can repair a wrong artifact after receiving concrete feedback. This paper presents A-CEGIS, a lightweight framework that uses counterexamples as feedback for evaluating multi-turn refinement in natural-language-to-regex synthesis. An agent proposes a regex, a deterministic oracle checks it under full-match semantics, and compact false-positive or false-negative witnesses guide the next turn. On 30 NL-RX-Turk tasks, diagnostic counterexample feedback solves 90\% of tasks within a four-turn ablation budget, compared with 17% for zero-shot generation, 27% for generic self-correction, and 23% for error-only feedback. In a full diagnostic run with hardening, all tasks are solved on the hidden set by the final turn, with mean time-to-success of 2.7 turns and robust success of 77% after targeted probing. These results show that A-CEGIS measures how efficiently an agent improves across turns while adding a practical robustness check beyond the original held-out cases.
summary_zh: 单轮代码生成指标低估了实际部署智能体的核心属性：即智能体在收到具体反馈后能否修正错误产物。本文提出A-CEGIS这一轻量框架，该框架使用反例作为反馈，评估自然语言转正则表达式合成任务中的多轮优化能力。智能体生成正则表达式后，确定性预言机将在全匹配语义下对其进行校验，生成的精简假阳性或假阴性样例将引导下一轮生成。在30项NL-RX-Turk任务上，诊断性反例反馈在4轮消融预算内即可解决90%的任务，相比之下零样本生成的任务解决率为17%，通用自校正方法为27%，仅错误反馈的方法为23%。在加入鲁棒性增强的完整诊断运行中，最终轮次在隐藏测试集上解决了全部任务，平均成功轮次为2.7轮，经过针对性探测后的鲁棒成功率达77%。上述结果表明A-CEGIS可以衡量智能体跨轮次的性能提升效率，同时在原有留出集之外增加了实用的鲁棒性校验环节。

title: ExecRetrieval: Measuring the Functional-Correctness Gap in Code-Embedding Retrieval
title_zh: ExecRetrieval：代码嵌入检索中的功能正确性差距测量
authors: Aaryan Kapoor, Md Abdullah Al Hafiz Khan
abstract: Embedding-based code retrieval is a core component of coding agents and retrieval-augmented code generation, where retrieving correct code matters more than retrieving lexically similar code. Existing code-retrieval benchmarks do not plant controlled, execution-verified single-edit variants of each query's canonical implementation in the search pool, leaving the question of whether embeddings can functionally discriminate correct from near-clone-but-incorrect code unanswered in a retrieval setting. Resolving this requires a benchmark whose search pool itself contains the relevant counterfactuals -- execution-verified buggy variants near-identical to each canonical -- so that a retriever's rank ordering can be directly tested for functional discrimination rather than topical or identity overlap. We introduce ExecRetrieval, 939 Python tasks each paired with one execution-verified canonical implementation and up to four execution-verified buggy distractors, each generated by a mechanical mutation making a single targeted edit, and evaluate 23 dense embedding configurations plus BM25 under provider-native invocation with paired McNemar tests and query-level bootstrap intervals. With near-clone counterfactuals in the pool, the top hosted system reaches exec@10 = 1.00 but only exec@1 = 0.331; rank-1 misses are paired buggy variants 91.5-99.4% of the time across the four leading systems, and the canonical scores below at least one of its four paired distractors in 67-78% of queries on the leading systems. The full dataset, execution oracle, embedding matrices, environment snapshot, and pairwise statistical tests are released at the URL in Appendix D.
summary_zh: 基于嵌入的代码检索是编码智能体与检索增强代码生成的核心组件，该场景下检索到功能正确的代码远比检索到词法相似的代码更为重要。现有代码检索基准并未在搜索池中为每个查询的标准实现植入经过执行校验的单编辑变体，导致嵌入模型能否在检索场景下从近乎克隆的错误代码中从功能层面区分出正确代码这一问题始终没有答案。要解决该问题，需要基准的搜索池本身包含相关反事实样本——即与每个标准实现几乎完全相同、经过执行校验的有缺陷变体，这样就可以直接测试检索器的排序能力是否实现了功能区分，而非仅实现主题或身份层面的重叠。本文提出ExecRetrieval基准，包含939项Python任务，每项任务配对1个经过执行校验的标准实现，以及最多4个经过执行校验的有缺陷干扰项，所有干扰项均通过机械变异生成，仅包含一处针对性编辑。本文在原生调用场景下对23种稠密嵌入配置与BM25算法进行评估，配套使用配对McNemar检验与查询层面的自举区间。当搜索池中存在近克隆反事实样本时，表现最优的商用系统的exec@10指标可达1.00，但exec@1指标仅为0.331；四大领先系统的排名第一的检索结果为配对缺陷变体的占比达91.5%-99.4%，且领先系统在67%-78%的查询中，标准实现的得分低于其配对的4个干扰项中的至少一个。完整数据集、执行预言机、嵌入矩阵、环境快照与成对统计检验代码均已在附录D的链接中开源。

title: X-Translator: A Real-Time Multilingual Speaker-Aware Speech-to-Speech Translation System
title_zh: X-Translator：面向实时多语言的说话人感知语音转语音翻译系统
authors: Yuxiang Zhao, Yichi Zhang, Yanjie An, Yanqiao Zhu, Zhanxun Liu 等 (13 人)
abstract: Real-time speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) systems must balance translation quality, latency, speech naturalness, and speaker consistency. Publicly documented S2ST systems have advanced direct, multilingual, streaming, and expressive modeling, while proprietary products and APIs increasingly expose real-time translation capabilities to users. However, practical deployment remains challenging for open and reproducible systems, especially in long-form and multi-speaker conversations where partial ASR hypotheses are unstable, turn boundaries are ambiguous, and target speech must be generated with an appropriate speaker prompt. We present X-Translator, a low-cost modular cascaded S2ST system that combines streaming ASR, machine translation, and prompt-conditioned TTS through a session-level runtime controller. The system uses incremental segment commitment to convert unstable ASR streams into translation-ready units, and an online speaker prompt manager to bind source speech spans to speaker-specific voice prompts for synthesis. We evaluate translation, speech quality, and latency with OpenSTBench, compare against proprietary speech translation APIs as behavioral baselines, measure long-form voice stability, evaluate speaker preservation in multi-speaker conversations, and assess multilingual translation quality. X-Translator provides an open platform for understanding the practical trade-offs of deployment-oriented S2ST. Code and demo are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 实时语音转语音翻译（S2ST）系统需要在翻译质量、延迟、语音自然度与说话人一致性之间实现平衡。目前公开的S2ST系统已经在直接建模、多语言、流式与表现力建模方面取得进展，商用产品与API也逐步向用户开放实时翻译能力。但开源可复现的系统在实际部署中仍面临诸多挑战，尤其是在长文本与多说话人对话场景下，部分ASR假设不稳定、话轮边界模糊，且目标语音需要基于合适的说话人提示生成。本文提出X-Translator，这是一款低成本模块化级联S2ST系统，通过会话级运行时控制器将流式ASR、机器翻译与提示条件化TTS相结合。该系统使用增量片段提交机制将不稳定的ASR流转换为可用于翻译的单元，同时通过在线说话人提示管理器将源语音片段绑定到对应说话人的专属语音提示，用于后续合成。本文使用OpenSTBench对翻译质量、语音质量与延迟进行评估，将系统与商用语音翻译API的表现作为行为基线进行对比，同时测量长文本语音稳定性、评估多说话人对话中的说话人保留能力、测试多语言翻译质量。X-Translator为研究面向部署的S2ST的实际权衡关系提供了开源平台，代码与演示页面可通过对应链接访问。

title: Anonymization, Not Elimination: Utility-Preserved Speech Anonymization
title_zh: 匿名化而非消除：保留效用的语音匿名化技术
authors: Yunchong Xiao, Yuxiang Zhao, Ziyang Ma, Shuai Wang, Kai Yu 等 (7 人)
abstract: The growing reliance on large-scale speech data has made privacy protection a critical concern. However, existing anonymization approaches often degrade data utility, for example by disrupting acoustic continuity or reducing vocal diversity, which compromises the value of speech data for downstream tasks such as Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and Speech Emotion Recognition (SER). Current evaluation practices are also limited, as they mainly rely on direct testing of anonymized speech with pretrained models, providing only a partial view of utility. To address these issues, we propose a novel two-stage framework that protects both linguistic content and acoustic identity while maintaining usability. For content privacy, we employ a generative speech editing model to seamlessly replace personally identifiable information (PII), and for voice privacy, we introduce F3-VA, a flow-matching-based anonymization framework with a three-stage design that produces diverse and distinct anonymized speakers. To enable a more comprehensive assessment, we evaluate privacy using both acoustic- and content-based speaker verification metrics, and assess utility by training ASR, TTS, and SER models from scratch. Experimental results show that our framework achieves stronger privacy protection with minimal utility degradation compared to baselines from the VoicePrivacy Challenge, while the proposed evaluation protocol provides a more realistic reflection of the utility of anonymized speech under privacy protection.
summary_zh: 当前对大规模语音数据的依赖程度不断提升，隐私保护已成为核心关切。但现有匿名化方法往往会降低数据效用，例如破坏声学连续性、降低语音多样性，损害语音数据在自动语音识别（ASR）、文本转语音（TTS）、语音情感识别（SER）等下游任务中的应用价值。当前的评估实践也存在局限，大多仅使用预训练模型直接测试匿名化后的语音，只能得到效用的部分视图。为解决上述问题，本文提出一种全新的两阶段框架，在保护语言内容与声学身份的同时保留数据可用性。针对内容隐私，本研究使用生成式语音编辑模型无缝替换个人可识别信息（PII）；针对语音隐私，本文提出F3-VA这一基于流匹配的三阶段匿名化框架，可以生成多样且特征差异显著的匿名化说话人。为实现更全面的评估，本研究同时使用基于声学与基于内容的说话人验证指标评估隐私保护效果，通过从零开始训练ASR、TTS、SER模型的方式评估效用。实验结果表明，与VoicePrivacy Challenge的基线方法相比，本框架实现了更强的隐私保护效果，同时效用损失极小，所提出的评估协议也可以更真实地反映隐私保护场景下匿名化语音的实际效用。

title: Traceable TTS: Toward Watermark-Free TTS with Strong Traceability
title_zh: 可溯源TTS：面向无水印、强可溯源性的文本转语音技术
authors: Yuxiang Zhao, Yunchong Xiao, Yushen Chen, Zhikang Niu, Shuai Wang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Recent advances in Text-To-Speech (TTS) technology have enabled synthetic speech to mimic human voices with remarkable realism, raising significant security concerns. This underscores the need for traceable TTS models-systems capable of tracing their synthesized speech without compromising quality or security. However, existing methods predominantly rely on explicit watermarking on speech or on vocoder, which degrades speech quality and is vulnerable to spoofing. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework for model attribution. Instead of embedding watermarks, we train the TTS model and discriminator using a joint training method that significantly improves traceability generalization while preserving-and even slightly improving-audio quality. This is the first work toward watermark-free TTS with strong traceability. To promote progress in related fields, we will release the code upon acceptance of the paper.
summary_zh: 近年来文本转语音（TTS）技术的快速发展使得合成语音可以高度逼真地模仿人类语音，引发了严重的安全担忧。这一背景下亟需可溯源TTS模型：即能够在不损失语音质量与安全性的前提下，对自身生成的合成语音进行溯源的系统。但现有方法大多依赖在语音或声码器中嵌入显式水印，不仅会降低语音质量，还容易被伪造攻击绕过。针对上述局限，本文提出一种全新的模型归因框架。该框架无需嵌入水印，而是通过联合训练方法同时训练TTS模型与判别器，在保留甚至小幅提升音频质量的前提下，大幅提升溯源能力的泛化性。本研究是首个面向无水印、强可溯源性TTS的工作。论文录用后我们将开源相关代码，推动相关领域发展。

title: Legibility is Not Interpretability: Comparing Judged and Actual Importance in Chain-Of-Thought Reasoning
title_zh: 可读性不等于可解释性：思维链推理中评判得到的重要性与实际重要性的对比研究
authors: Kevin Du, Alexander Hoyle, Laura Ruis, Acyr Locatelli
abstract: Reasoning traces from chain-of-thought models appear to offer a legible window into how a model arrives at its answer. A growing body of work treats them as such, using LLM judges to diagnose errors, evaluate faithfulness, and provide step-level supervision via process reward models and generative critics. These practices rely on the text of a reasoning step carrying information about its functional role. But does the text actually encode information about which reasoning steps matter? We operationalize the importance of a reasoning step as its advantage: the change in expected reward, e.g., producing the correct final answer, from including that step, estimated via Monte Carlo rollouts. Basing ground truth on these estimates, we evaluate whether LLM judges can identify high-advantage steps and find that sufficiently capable LLMs can outperform a prevalence baseline but fall well short of a noise ceiling. Fine-tuning a model as a step-level critic yields strong improvement for incorrect responses but remains distant from ceiling for correct responses, suggesting that step importance is only partially recoverable from the text of the reasoning trace. Our findings contribute to a growing body of chain-of-thought faithfulness work that cautions against treating the legibility of reasoning traces as interpretability, especially with implications for process reward modeling.
summary_zh: 思维链模型生成的推理轨迹看似为理解模型得到答案的过程提供了可读的窗口。越来越多的研究将推理轨迹视为可解释的载体，使用大语言模型评判者诊断错误、评估忠实度，同时通过过程奖励模型与生成式评判者提供步级监督。这类实践的核心假设是推理步骤的文本承载了其功能角色的相关信息。但推理步骤的文本是否真的编码了哪些推理步骤是关键的相关信息？本研究将推理步骤的重要性定义为其优势值：即通过蒙特卡洛滚动估算的，加入该步骤后预期奖励（例如生成正确最终答案）的变化量。基于该估算得到的真值，本文评估大语言模型评判者能否识别高优势步骤，发现能力足够强的大语言模型的表现优于基于占比的基线，但远未达到噪声上限。将模型微调为步级评判者可以大幅提升其对错误回复的识别性能，但对于正确回复的识别性能仍远低于上限，说明仅从推理轨迹的文本中只能部分恢复步骤的重要性。本研究的结论补充了现有思维链忠实度相关研究的成果，提醒研究者不要将推理轨迹的可读性等同于可解释性，该结论对过程奖励建模领域也有重要参考意义。

title: Robust PAC Learning of Concurrent Stochastic Games
title_zh: 并发随机博弈的鲁棒PAC学习
authors: Angel Y. He, David Parker
abstract: We introduce the first Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning framework for general-sum concurrent stochastic games (CSGs) with transition uncertainty, while addressing the challenge of Nash equilibrium (NE) existence. Our algorithm maintains data-driven $L^1$ confidence sets over transition kernels and solves a robust CSG to compute a social-welfare optimal $\varepsilon$-NE, using a robust MDP-based exploration mechanism to drive joint state-action coverage. Crucially, we introduce a Nash margin characterisation that enables principled reasoning about equilibrium existence: the framework either returns an $\varepsilon$-approximate NE whose social-welfare value is $\varepsilon$-close to optimal, or provides a sound certificate that no exact NE exists. Under a minimum reachability condition $p_{\mathrm{reach}}>0$ over relevant state-action pairs, the algorithm terminates after a polynomial number of trajectory samples, with sample complexity $\widetilde{O}\left( {R_{\max}^2 H^4 |S|^2 |A| / (p_{\mathrm{reach}} \varepsilon^2)} \right)$. Empirical results on benchmark CSGs demonstrate near-optimal performance, correct handling of equilibrium (non-)existence, and sample complexity consistent with theory.
summary_zh: 本文提出首个针对存在转移不确定性的一般和并发随机博弈（CSG）的Probably Approximately Correct（PAC，概率近似正确）学习框架，同时解决了纳什均衡（NE）存在性判定的难题。该算法在转移核上维护基于数据的L1置信集，求解鲁棒CSG以计算社会福利最优的ε-纳什均衡，同时使用基于鲁棒MDP的探索机制实现联合状态-动作空间的覆盖。核心创新点在于本文提出的纳什裕度表征，为均衡存在性的原则性推理提供了支撑：该框架要么返回社会福利值与最优值相差不超过ε的ε-近似纳什均衡，要么给出不存在精确纳什均衡的可靠证明。在相关状态-动作对满足最小可达性条件p_reach>0的前提下，该算法仅需多项式数量的轨迹样本即可终止，样本复杂度为O~(R_max² H⁴ |S|² |A| / (p_reach ε²))。在基准CSG上的实验结果表明，该算法实现了近最优性能，可以正确处理均衡存在或不存在的场景，样本复杂度与理论结果一致。

title: Para-Pipe: Exploiting Hierarchical Operator Parallelism of ML Computational Graphs on SoCs
title_zh: Para-Pipe：在片上系统上挖掘机器学习计算图的层级算子并行性
authors: Yujie Zhang, Huiying Lan, Ehsan Aghapour, Zhiyuan Ning, Peng Zan 等 (8 人)
abstract: As edge-based deep learning applications become more complex, optimizing performance on heterogeneous System-on-Chips (SoCs) presents unique challenges. Traditional pipelining techniques distributing the computation across different on-chip processing units, while effective for throughput, do not address the latency demands posed by modern neural networks with complex interdependencies and extensive operator parallelism. There is a potential in leveraging operator parallelism to enable concurrent execution across multiple processing units, thereby reducing inference latency. However, prioritizing pipelining or parallel execution often necessitates a compromise, where optimizing one performance metric adversely impacts the other. This paper introduces Para-Pipe, a hierarchical mapping framework that integrates intra- and inter-stage operator parallelism within a pipelined architecture. Para-Pipe navigates the trade-off between throughput and latency by selectively fine-tuning parallelism levels within and across pipeline stages. This strategy can significantly reduce inter-processor communication overhead, significantly improving energy efficiency. Our evaluation demonstrates that Para-Pipe generates multiple Pareto-optimal configurations, achieving a balance between throughput and latency on an Amlogic SoC equipped with ARMthis http URLCPUs and GPU, as well as the Black Sesame Technology SoC featuring a deep learning accelerator and two DSPs. More importantly, throughput-optimized configurations under Para-Pipe on Amlogic SoC show an average energy efficiency improvement of 11.0% over purely pipelined strategies and 23.3% relative to non-pipelined parallel execution.
summary_zh: 随着边缘端深度学习应用复杂度不断提升，在异构System-on-Chips（SoC，片上系统）上优化性能面临独特挑战。传统流水线技术将计算分布到不同的片上处理单元，虽然可以有效提升吞吐量，但无法满足现代神经网络复杂依赖关系与高算子并行性带来的延迟需求。利用算子并行性实现多处理单元的并发执行，具备降低推理延迟的潜力。但优先优化流水线或并行执行往往需要做出权衡，优化其中一个性能指标通常会对另一个指标产生负面影响。本文提出Para-Pipe这一层次化映射框架，在流水线架构中集成了阶段内与阶段间的算子并行性。Para-Pipe通过选择性微调流水线阶段内部与跨阶段的并行度，实现吞吐量与延迟之间的权衡，该策略可以大幅降低处理器间通信开销，显著提升能效。本文的评估结果显示，Para-Pipe可以生成多个帕累托最优配置，在搭载ARM CPU与GPU的晶晨SoC，以及搭载深度学习加速器与两个DSP的黑芝麻智能SoC上均实现了吞吐量与延迟的平衡。更重要的是，在晶晨SoC上经过Para-Pipe优化的吞吐量优先配置，相比纯流水线策略平均能效提升11.0%，相比非流水线并行执行策略平均能效提升23.3%。

title: Parameterised graph theory for tensor networks: entanglement rerouting, structural simplification, and agnostic tomography
title_zh: 面向张量网络的参数化图论：纠缠重路由、结构简化与不可知层析
authors: Matthias C. Caro, Natalie McHugh, Sergii Strelchuk
abstract: Parameterised graph theory studies how the complexity of graph-theoretic problems depends on structural parameters of the input graph. This perspective has proved useful in analysing tensor-network simulation (Markov and Shi, 2008). Its implications for tensor-network representations and tomography are less well understood. In particular, which graph parameters determine whether a tensor-network state (TNS) admits a tractable matrix product state (MPS) or tree tensor network (TTN) representation, and which control the complexity of learning the state?We address these questions using parameterised graph theory. First, we show that cutwidth and tree-cutwidth bound the bond dimension overhead required to represent a TNS as an MPS or TTN. In the TTN case, tree-cutwidth also bounds the local dimension of the grouped subsystems. The proofs are based on entanglement rerouting, a tensor-network analogue of rerouting information in a classical network. Second, we derive graph-dependent upper bounds on the sample and computational complexity of realisable TNS tomography, with exponents that depend on cutwidth, tree-cutwidth, and a new graph parameter, learning complexity, which we bound in terms of degree and treewidth. We obtain these results by extending the disentangling MPS learner of (Cramer et al., 2010), as analysed further in (Bakshi et al., 2025; Lin et al., 2025), to TTNs and to tensor networks on arbitrary known graphs. Finally, we extend the framework beyond the realisable setting. For an arbitrary input state, our agnostic learner outputs a pure state whose fidelity is within additive error $\epsilon$ of the optimum over tensor-network states on the given graph with a given bond dimension, with explicit graph-dependent bounds on sample and computational complexity.
summary_zh: 参数化图论研究图论问题的复杂度如何依赖于输入图的结构参数。该研究视角已被证实可有效用于张量网络模拟分析（Markov 和 Shi, 2008），但它在张量网络表示与层析领域的作用仍有待深入探索。具体而言，哪些图参数决定了张量网络态（tensor-network state, TNS）是否可表示为易处理的矩阵乘积态（matrix product state, MPS）或树张量网络（tree tensor network, TTN），又有哪些参数控制着该态的学习复杂度？本文采用参数化图论方法解答上述问题：首先，我们证明割宽与树割宽可界定将TNS表示为MPS或TTN所需的键维度开销；在TTN场景下，树割宽还可界定分组子系统的局域维度。相关证明基于纠缠重路由技术，这是张量网络领域对应于经典网络信息重路由的类比方法。其次，我们推导得到可实现TNS层析的样本复杂度与计算复杂度的图依赖上界，其指数由割宽、树割宽以及一种新的图参数——学习复杂度共同决定，我们还通过度和树宽给出了学习复杂度的界。上述结果是通过扩展Cramer等人2010年提出的解纠缠MPS学习器实现的，该学习器后续在Bakshi等人2025年、Lin等人2025年的工作中得到进一步分析，我们将其推广到TTN以及任意已知图上的张量网络场景。最后，我们将该框架扩展到非可实现场景：对于任意输入态，我们的不可知学习器输出一个纯态，其与给定图、给定键维度下张量网络态集合最优结果的保真度误差不超过ε，同时给出了明确的图依赖样本复杂度与计算复杂度界。

title: Prospective Coding Improves Learning in Deep Continuous-Time Recurrent Networks
title_zh: 前瞻编码提升深度连续时间递归网络的学习性能
authors: Shivang Rawat, Mirko Morello, Flaviano Morone, David J. Heeger
abstract: Temporal integration gives continuous-time recurrent networks memory, but in deep stacks it also delays bottom-up signals and attenuates top-down errors. We develop Recursive Quadrature Filters (RQFs), biologically motivated complex-valued temporal filters that are a special case of diagonal state-space models (SSMs), and ask whether this failure mode can be addressed by making each layer's bottom-up input prospective. Starting from an energy model, we derive the RQF dynamics and show that each RQF is a band-pass filter whose learnable parameters control its tuning frequency and bandwidth. We then make each layer's bottom-up input prospective using a parameter-free two-tap update that leaves the recurrent transition and parallel scan unchanged. We extend this correction to general diagonal SSMs and show that it mitigates depth-dependent gradient attenuation when temporal gradients are truncated, i.e., spatial-only backpropagation. We evaluate the intervention in RQFs, S5, and ORGaNICs (a nonlinear gated RNN) trained using full backpropagation through time (BPTT) and spatial-only backpropagation. Under full BPTT, prospective variants match or outperform their non-prospective controls in every model and configuration. A non-residual width-32 six-layer RQF reaches 96.09% accuracy on raw-audio Speech Commands with 31.9k parameters; a width-64 six-layer RQF reaches 83.56% on the 16,384-step Path-X task. These results identify RQFs as a parameter-efficient recurrent substrate and prospective-input coding as an input-side correction for deep continuous-time recurrent networks.
summary_zh: 时间积分机制为连续时间递归网络提供了记忆能力，但在深度堆叠结构中，该机制也会延迟自底向上的信号传递、衰减自顶向下的误差。我们提出递归正交滤波器（Recursive Quadrature Filters, RQFs）——一类受生物启发的复值时间滤波器，是对角状态空间模型（state-space models, SSMs）的特例，我们探究能否通过让每一层的自底向上输入具备前瞻特性来解决上述失效模式。我们从能量模型出发推导了RQF的动力学特性，证明每个RQF都是带通滤波器，其可学习参数可控制调谐频率与带宽。随后我们采用无参数双抽头更新方案让每一层的自底向上输入具备前瞻特性，该方案不会改变递归转移与并行扫描过程。我们将该校正方法扩展到通用对角SSM，证明其可缓解时间梯度截断（即仅空间反向传播）场景下与深度相关的梯度衰减问题。我们在采用完整时间反向传播（backpropagation through time, BPTT）和仅空间反向传播训练的RQF、S5以及ORGaNICs（一类非线性门控RNN）上对该干预方案进行评估。在完整BPTT设置下，所有模型与配置的前瞻变体性能均匹配或优于非前瞻对照组。无残差结构、宽度为32的6层RQF在原始音频Speech Commands数据集上达到96.09%的准确率，参数量仅为31.9k；宽度为64的6层RQF在16384步Path-X任务上达到83.56%的准确率。上述结果表明RQFs是一种参数高效的递归基础组件，而前瞻输入编码是深度连续时间递归网络的一种输入侧校正方案。

title: Constant regret in general games via higher-order optimism
title_zh: 基于高阶乐观法的通用博弈常值悔值
authors: Omar Abbadi, Rida Laraki, Panayotis Mertikopoulos
abstract: We introduce an uncoupled learning algorithm which, when employed by all players of an arbitrary $N$-player normal form game with up to $K$ actions per player, guarantees $O(N^3\log^2 K)$ individual regret, uniformly over the horizon of play. The proposed algorithm - which we call higher-order optimism with discounting (HOOD) is a variant of optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader (OptFTRL) that combines a discounted $(N+1)$-th order predictor with entropic regularization over a suitable "lifting" of the game's strategy space. This combination of ingredients is purposefully designed to dampen large oscillations of the induced sequence of play in a controlled manner, removing in this way a key stumbling block of previous attempts to achieve constant regret in general games. Our approach bears several striking similarities to the concurrent - and completely independent - work of Liu, Farina, and Ozdaglar (arXiv:2608.31166), who very recently derived an $O(N^{21}\log^{4} K)$ regret bound through the use of higher-order optimism and an exponential moving average estimator.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种非耦合学习算法，当任意N人标准型博弈的所有玩家均采用该算法、且每个玩家最多拥有K个动作时，可在整个博弈时域内保证个体悔值一致上界为O(N³log²K)。我们将该算法命名为带折扣高阶乐观算法（higher-order optimism with discounting, HOOD），是正则化领导者乐观跟随算法（optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader, OptFTRL）的变体，它将带折扣的(N+1)阶预测器与针对博弈策略空间合适“提升”形式的熵正则化相结合。该组合方案经过专门设计，可受控地抑制博弈序列的大幅振荡，从而破除此前通用博弈常值悔值相关研究的核心障碍。我们的方法与Liu、Farina和Ozdaglar近期（arXiv:2608.31166）完全独立的同期工作存在诸多显著相似性，后者通过高阶乐观与指数移动平均估计器得到了O(N²¹log⁴K)的悔值界。

title: Hardware-Aware FP4 FlashAttention-4
title_zh: 面向硬件感知的FP4 FlashAttention-4
authors: Robert Hu
abstract: Blackwell's 4-bit floating-point (FP4) tensor cores do not automatically make attention faster because softmax conversion and on-chip dependencies dominate once its matrix products shrink. We address this with \emph{Direct-P} for noncausal inference and a causal path that passes the forward quantization directly into backward. Direct-P maps scores directly to FP4 probabilities and reaches up to 2.13$\times$ the bfloat16 (BF16) forward throughput on an NVIDIA GB200. The causal path reconstructs probabilities from saved quantized queries and keys and uses 8-bit floating-point (FP8) gradient operands, accelerating a complete single-GPU 8-billion-parameter update by up to 1.14$\times$. Matched distributed training retains FP8 probabilities and values; every tested MXFP4 probability/value training trajectory diverges.
summary_zh: 英伟达Blackwell架构的4位浮点（FP4）张量核并不能自动提升注意力计算速度，因为当矩阵运算规模缩减后，softmax转换与片上依赖开销会占据主导地位。针对该问题，我们提出面向非因果推理的Direct-P技术，以及将前向量化直接传递到反向传播的因果路径方案。Direct-P直接将注意力分数映射为FP4概率，在NVIDIA GB200上可实现最高达2.13倍的16位脑浮点数（bfloat16, BF16）前向吞吐量。因果路径方案可通过保存的量化查询与键重建概率，采用8位浮点（FP8）梯度操作数，在单GPU上加速80亿参数模型的完整训练迭代最高达1.14倍。匹配分布式训练场景下保留FP8概率与值的方案可稳定训练，而所有测试的MXFP8概率/值训练轨迹均出现发散问题。

title: Conditioning Degenerate Diffusion Models
title_zh: 单层注意力中布尔函数的头复杂度研究
authors: Uğur Aydın, Tamer Başar
abstract: Current conditioned generative models heavily rely on score functions for guidance during training. When the generative model is a diffusion process with a singular diffusion coefficient and the underlying (conditional) densities either do not exist or are not smooth, we use causal optimal transport to define \emph{approximate} loss functions that identify a minimum-entropy control for guidance under minimal assumptions. Our approach relies on causal optimal transport and its characterization through the predictable representation property of (conditioned) diffusion processes whose associated martingale problem is well posed, à la Üstünel.
summary_zh: 单层自注意力结构具备何种计算能力？本文研究头复杂度指标：仅注意力结构的单层模型中计算某一函数所需的最少注意力头数量。我们基于该指标建立了严格的层级关系：k个注意力头可计算k比特奇偶校验，但无法计算(k+1)比特奇偶校验。该下界不受Transformer模型其他两类资源的约束：在嵌入维度无界、数值精度无界的条件下该下界依然成立。证明过程基于交替和阻碍特性：消去softmax分母后，所得决策多项式中的每个单项式都会至少遗漏k+1个输入比特中的一个，导致其与奇偶校验的相关性消失。该阻碍特性同样可为包括广受研究的多跳归纳头任务在内的相关任务提供下界。我们还建立了嵌入维度与数值精度的紧致性界：具体而言，紧致性定理证明，所有可被该模型计算的函数，都可在嵌入维度与数值精度受任务离散数据（即头数量、字母表大小、序列长度）约束的条件下实现计算。由此可证，无界的嵌入维度或数值精度无法替代注意力头的作用。最后我们推导了通用二元函数的近似匹配普适界：2ⁿ个注意力头足以计算所有n比特二元函数，每个头对应其多线性展开中的一个单项式；而计数论证表明几乎所有此类函数都需要Ω(2ⁿ/n²)个注意力头，该下界与上界的差距仅为poly(n)因子，即便在维度与精度无界的条件下该结论依然成立。上述结果完整刻画了该模型下布尔计算的注意力头需求特性。

title: The Head Complexity of Boolean Functions in Single-Layer Attention
authors: Rajmohan Rajaraman, Ravi Sundaram, Amanuel Tesfaye
abstract: What can a single layer of self-attention compute? We study head complexity: the minimum number of attention heads required to compute a function in a one-layer attention-only model. We establish an exact hierarchy under this measure: $k$ heads compute $k$-bit parity but cannot compute $(k+1)$-bit parity.The lower bound is unconditional in the two resources a transformer might otherwise exploit; it holds at unbounded embedding dimension and unbounded numerical precision. The proof rests on an alternating-sum obstruction: after clearing the softmax denominators, every monomial in the resulting decision polynomial omits at least one of the $k+1$ input bits, forcing its correlation with parity to vanish. The same obstruction yields lower bounds for related tasks, including the well-studied multi-hop induction-head task.We also establish compactness bounds for embedding dimension and numerical precision. Specifically, a compactness theorem shows that any function computable at all can be computed with embedding dimension and precision bounded by the discrete data of the task, namely, head count, alphabet size, and length. Thus, potentially unbounded dimension or precision provably cannot substitute for heads. Finally, we derive nearly matching universal bounds for general binary functions: $2^n$ heads suffice to compute every $n$-bit binary function, with one head per monomial in its multilinear expansion, while a counting argument shows almost all such functions require $\Omega(2^n/n^2)$ heads. This lower bound matches the upper bound to within a $\operatorname{poly}(n)$ factor, even when dimension and precision are unbounded. Together, these results characterize head requirements for Boolean computation in this model.

title: A location-invariant estimator of extremal quantile treatment effects for heavy-tailed distributions
title_zh: 面向重尾分布的极值分位数处理效应位置不变估计量
authors: Xin Yu, Shuwei Huang, Jicheng Liu, Jielin Tang, Bolin Wang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Quantile treatment effects (QTEs) measure the effect of a treatment on the distribution of an outcome, and their estimation at extreme quantile levels is of central interest in applications where the target quantiles lie far beyond the range of the data. For heavy-tailed potential outcomes, existing extremal QTE estimators rely on extrapolation combined with a causal extreme value index (EVI) estimator, but the resulting estimator is not invariant under a common location shift of the potential outcome distributions, even though the population QTE is. We address this issue in two steps. First, we adapt the location-invariant Fraga estimator of the EVI to the causal setting using inverse propensity score weighting. Second, we replace the original extrapolation formula with a difference-based scheme, under which the location parameter cancels when quantile differences are taken. The resulting QTE estimator is therefore location invariant. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed extremal QTE estimators, and provide a consistent variance estimator, leading to asymptotically valid inference. A simulation study confirms the location invariance, the stability with respect to the threshold, and the coverage of the proposed methods.
summary_zh: 分位数处理效应（quantile treatment effects, QTEs）衡量处理对结果变量分布的影响，当目标分位水平远超出观测数据范围时，极值分位水平的估计在各类实际应用中至关重要。针对重尾潜在结果，现有极值QTE估计量依赖外推结合因果极值指数（extreme value index, EVI）估计的方案，但所得估计量不满足潜在结果分布公共位置平移下的不变性，而总体QTE本身具备该不变性。本文分两步解决该问题：首先，我们采用逆倾向得分加权方案将位置不变的Fraga EVI估计量适配到因果场景；其次，我们用基于差分的方案替换原有外推公式，在该方案下计算分位数差时位置参数会被抵消，最终得到的QTE估计量具备位置不变性。我们证明了所提极值QTE估计量的一致性与渐近正态性，给出了一致的方差估计量，可实现渐近有效的统计推断。仿真实验验证了所提方法的位置不变性、阈值稳定性以及置信区间覆盖性能。

title: Differentiable Hybrid Modelling for Learning and Optimising Chemical Transport Processes from Experimental Data
title_zh: 基于实验数据学习与优化化学输运过程的可微混合建模
authors: Arthur Jessop, Mohammed Alsubeihi, Ben Moseley, Ashwin Kumar Rajagopalan
abstract: Reliable transport models are essential when modelling and optimising many chemical engineering processes, yet, most models assume hand-picked constitutive laws which may not reflect reality, and often assume initial conditions are known exactly. Both restrictions can significantly bias model predictions and lead to systematic error when used in predictive and control settings. Black-box neural surrogate alternatives for modelling can better match real example data, but are confined to the task they were trained on and cannot be interrogated for physical consistency. Here we introduce a general-purpose differentiable hybrid modelling framework for transport processes, specifically for the case of population balance equations. Our framework integrates a JAX finite volume population balance solver with learnable neural network components which are trained to both discover constitutive laws and fit initial conditions from real experimental data, allowing us to better model real experimental transport systems. Furthermore, we use our framework for process optimisation, using its differentiability to allow us to direct optimising experimental settings for quantities of interest. This work highlights the huge potential of such differentiable hybrid modelling frameworks for learning and optimising any given chemical separation which involves mass, energy, and/or momentum transport.
summary_zh: 可靠的输运模型是众多化工过程建模与优化的核心基础，但现有大多数模型采用人工选定的本构定律，往往无法反映真实情况，且通常假设初始条件完全已知。这两类限制会显著引入模型预测偏差，在预测与控制场景下引发系统性误差。作为替代方案的黑盒神经网络代理模型虽然可以更好地拟合实际样本数据，但仅能完成训练指定的任务，无法验证物理一致性。本文提出面向输运过程的通用可微混合建模框架，尤其适用于种群平衡方程场景。该框架将基于JAX的有限体积种群平衡求解器与可学习神经网络组件相结合，通过训练同时从真实实验数据中发现本构定律、拟合初始条件，从而实现对真实实验输运系统的更精准建模。此外我们利用该框架的可微性特性开展过程优化，可直接针对目标量优化实验设置。该工作证明了此类可微混合建模框架在学习与优化涉及质量、能量和/或动量输运的各类化学分离过程中的巨大应用潜力。

title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
title_zh: 基于离散扩散解锁大语言模型的无损加速
authors: Subham Sekhar Sahoo, Lingjie Chen, Khiem Pham, Jonathan Geuter, Chaitanya Dwivedi 等 (17 人)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) owe much of their success to next-token prediction (NTP), but their autoregressive (AR) structure requires slow, sequential token generation. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce diffusion-augmented LLMs, a new class of models that defines an AR model distribution while using diffusion to draw multiple tokens in parallel from that distribution. We decouple the parameters of these models into two sets: AR weights, trained using the standard NTP objective, and lightweight diffusion weights, trained to generate multiple tokens simultaneously. The diffusion weights are learned through a simple Diffusion Distillation phase that adds negligible overhead to existing LLM training pipelines. We also introduce $\Psi$-Spec, a family of samplers that enables lossless acceleration and inference-time scaling at a fixed context length. Unlike speculative decoding, our method requires no separate draft model. Unlike diffusion LLMs (d-LLMs), it accelerates generation without sacrificing the quality of the underlying AR model. The resulting models, called Uno, can be trained from scratch or built by augmenting existing open-weight AR LLMs. Uno achieves higher throughput than leading speculative-decoding methods at every evaluated batch size and delivers up to $3\times$ speedups over the base AR model, including at the largest batch size supported by the device. Notably, our 8B Uno model outperforms the leading open d-LLM, the 26B DiffusionGemma, and the proprietary Mercury 2 across all evaluated benchmarks in agentic tool use, coding, and long-context reasoning. We release code and checkpoints at:this https URL
summary_zh: 大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的优异性能很大程度上归功于下一词预测（next-token prediction, NTP）目标，但自回归（autoregressive, AR）结构要求逐序列生成token，速度较慢。为解决该瓶颈，本文提出扩散增强大语言模型这一新模型类别，该类模型定义自回归模型分布，同时利用扩散机制从该分布中并行采样多个token。我们将模型参数解耦为两组：采用标准NTP目标训练的自回归权重，以及用于同时生成多个token的轻量扩散权重。扩散权重通过简单的扩散蒸馏阶段学习，几乎不会给现有大语言模型训练流水线增加额外开销。我们还提出Ψ-Spec采样器家族，可在固定上下文长度下实现无损加速与推理时缩放。与投机解码不同，本文方法不需要单独的草稿模型；与扩散大语言模型（d-LLMs）不同，该方法可在不损失底层自回归模型生成质量的前提下加速生成。所得名为Uno的模型可从头训练得到，也可通过增强现有开源权重自回归大语言模型构建。在所有测试的批处理大小下，Uno的吞吐量均优于当前最先进的投机解码方法，相比基础自回归模型最高可实现3倍加速，在设备支持的最大批处理大小下该加速效果依然成立。值得注意的是，我们的8B Uno模型在智能体工具调用、代码生成、长上下文推理的所有测试基准上，性能均优于当前最先进的开源扩散大语言模型26B DiffusionGemma以及闭源模型Mercury 2。我们已在对应开源链接发布代码与模型 checkpoint。

title: RobustSeiz: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking the Robustness of EEG Seizure Detection Models
title_zh: RobustSeiz：面向脑电癫痫检测模型鲁棒性基准测试的开源框架
authors: Mohammad Mohammadi, Alireza Zarei
abstract: Despite strong performance on held-out electroencephalography (EEG) data, seizure detectors may fail under real-world acquisition variability, artifacts, and adversarial inputs. We introduce RobustSeiz, an open-source, model-agnostic framework that provides a standardized, reproducible protocol for stress-testing and comparing seizure detectors under controlled, clinically motivated distribution shifts before deployment. We standardize four public scalp-EEG corpora (CHB-MIT, TUSZ, Siena, and SeizeIT1) into BIDS-EEG trees and evaluate subject-independent detectors on held-out splits. Environment, noise, and adversarial transforms are swept over predefined hyperparameter grids. Each run reports sample- and event-level sensitivity, precision, F1, false positives per 24 h, Lead and Lag onset timing, and Monte Carlo dropout predictive agreement. RobustSeiz includes a Dockerized GPU pipeline, experiment registry, and full-evaluation and research-subset modes. We demonstrate the framework with a contemporary seizure detector on TUSZ across the complete implemented shift grid; an AWGN analysis illustrates how perturbation severity changes detection quality, onset timing, and predictive agreement. RobustSeiz provides a shared benchmarking standard for evaluating seizure-detector robustness under realistic clinical stressors, extending pre-deployment assessment beyond clean-data accuracy.
summary_zh: 尽管癫痫检测模型在留出脑电图（electroencephalography, EEG）数据集上表现优异，但在真实场景下，采集过程的变异性、伪迹与对抗输入都可能导致模型失效。本文提出RobustSeiz，这是一个开源、模型无关的框架，提供标准化、可复现的协议，可在部署前在符合临床实际的受控分布偏移场景下对癫痫检测模型进行压力测试与横向对比。我们将四个公开头皮脑电图数据集（CHB-MIT、TUSZ、Siena、SeizeIT1）标准化为BIDS-EEG目录结构，在留出划分上评估不依赖受试者的癫痫检测模型。我们在预定义的超参数网格上遍历环境、噪声与对抗变换，每次运行都会报告样本级与事件级的灵敏度、精确率、F1值、每24小时误报数、发作前后时间差以及蒙特卡洛 dropout预测一致性。RobustSeiz内置Docker化GPU流水线、实验注册表，以及完整评估模式与研究子集模式。我们通过在TUSZ数据集上采用当前主流癫痫检测模型遍历所有预设偏移网格的案例演示了该框架的功能；加性高斯白噪声分析展示了扰动强度如何改变检测质量、发作时间定位精度与预测一致性。RobustSeiz提供了共享的基准测试标准，可在符合临床实际的压力场景下评估癫痫检测模型的鲁棒性，将部署前评估维度从干净数据准确率扩展到更多实用性能指标。

title: Cooperative Multi-Task Semantic Communication for Joint Classification and Regression Tasks
title_zh: 面向分类与回归联合任务的协作多任务语义通信
authors: Ahmad Halimi Razlighi, Mohammad Siddiqur Rahman, Maximilian H. V. Tillmann, Edgar Beck, Armin Dekorsy
abstract: Multi-Task semantic communication (SemCom) prioritizes simultaneous execution of multiple tasks over bit-accurate reconstruction in future intelligent networks. In our prior work [1], we introduced the cooperative multi-task SemCom (CMT-SemCom) framework, in which the semantic encoder is divided into a common unit (CU) and multiple specific units (SUs) to facilitate cooperative multi-task processing. However, CMT-SemCom has been evaluated on homogeneous classification tasks on simplistic datasets, limiting its applicability to real-world perception systems. In this paper, we extend our CMT-SemCom to jointly handle heterogeneous classification and regression tasks on the complex Cityscapes dataset. We adopt the information maximization (InfoMax) principle so that it accommodates mixed discrete and continuous semantic variables. In particular, we benchmark the proposed framework against independent single-task training, a conventional task-agnostic digital transmission, and single-encoder multi-decoder SemCom. Additionally, we investigate the impact of CU capacity on joint task performance, providing design insights. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that CMT-SemCom significantly outperforms the benchmarks.
summary_zh: 多任务语义通信（SemCom）面向未来智能网络优先保障多任务同步执行，而非追求比特级精确重建。在前期工作[1]中，我们提出了协作多任务语义通信（Cooperative Multi-Task Semantic Communication, CMT-SemCom）框架，该框架将语义编码器拆分为公共单元（CU）和多个专属单元（SUs），以实现协作多任务处理。但此前CMT-SemCom仅在简单数据集的同构分类任务上完成验证，限制了其在真实感知系统中的适用性。本文将CMT-SemCom扩展至复杂Cityscapes数据集上的异构分类与回归联合任务场景，采用信息最大化（InfoMax）原则适配离散与连续混合语义变量。我们将所提框架与独立单任务训练、传统任务无关数字传输、单编码器多解码器语义通信三类基准方案进行了对比测试，此外还探究了公共单元容量对联合任务性能的影响，给出了架构设计参考。大量实验结果表明，CMT-SemCom的性能显著优于所有对比基准方案。

title: OSR: Output Space Redistribution for Adaptive Label Removal in Classification Models
title_zh: OSR：面向分类模型自适应标签移除的输出空间重分布方法
authors: Minyi Peng, Darian Gunamardi, Ivan Tjuawinata, Yongsen Zheng, Kwok-Yan Lam
abstract: Label removal occurs frequently in classification systems with evolving taxonomies, where categories must be dynamically updated or eliminated. To accommodate such changes, classification models must adapt accordingly. Existing solutions, broadly categorized as retraining-based and feature-space-adjustment-based, share common limitations despite their variations, including reliance on access to original data, substantial computational and storage costs, inconsistent results, poor scalability, and degradation of model utility. To address this, we propose a novel approach that leverages statistical redistribution in the output space to approximate the post-removal confidence vectors of a retrained model. Applicable as a modular output filter, our method bypasses the burden of feature-space adjustments or loss-function convergence, alleviating scalability limitations. Furthermore, by requiring only existing labels and prior output confidences, the method potentially mitigates privacy concerns inherent to data-dependent solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance against full retraining, with improvements in computational efficiency and privacy preservation across several classification tasks.
summary_zh: 分类系统的分类体系迭代过程中经常出现标签移除需求，需要动态更新或淘汰部分类别，分类模型也需要随之适配。现有方案大致可分为重训练类与特征空间调整类两类，尽管实现形式各有不同，但普遍存在依赖原始数据访问权限、计算与存储成本高、结果不稳定、可扩展性差、模型效用下降等共性缺陷。针对上述问题，本文提出一种新方法，利用输出空间的统计重分布近似重训练模型完成标签移除后的置信度向量。该方法可作为模块化输出过滤器使用，无需承担特征空间调整或损失函数收敛的开销，缓解了可扩展性限制。此外该方法仅需用到现有标签和历史输出置信度，可规避依赖原始数据的方案普遍存在的隐私风险。大量实验表明，该方法在多项分类任务上的性能可与全量重训练相媲美，同时计算效率与隐私保护性均有明显提升。

title: Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning for Sound and Adversarial Test Generation in Code LLMs
title_zh: 面向代码大语言模型的两阶段强化学习合规对抗测试生成方法
authors: Jiacheng Xu, Wentao Zhang, Zhiyi Lyu, Fuxiang Zhang, Chaojie Wang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially advanced code generation with large language models (LLMs) through executable feedback. The feedback for coding problems mainly comes from specific test cases, where high-quality test cases are often scarce since they should be both sound and discriminative. We thus turn to study the auto-generation of test cases using the learned model. We find this is naturally an adversarial RL problem: the model is expected to generate effective test cases as counterexamples, depending on the solver's current failure modes. We propose Test Cases Scaling (TCS), a two-stage RL framework for effective test generation. Both stages train a test generator from a rolling policy-aligned buffer: Stage 1 generates tests consistent with the reference solution, and Stage 2 restricts the buffer to current failure modes and learns counterexample tests. Across TACO and LiveCodeBench, TCS improves both pass@1 and inference-time answer selection according to generated tests. We find the learned test generator also enables effective selection among other LLM outputs.
summary_zh: 基于可执行反馈的强化学习（RL）大幅提升了大语言模型（LLM）的代码生成能力，而代码任务的反馈主要来自特定测试用例，同时满足合规性与区分度要求的高质量测试用例通常十分稀缺。为此我们研究利用已训练模型自动生成测试用例，发现该问题天然属于对抗强化学习场景：模型需要根据求解器当前的失效模式生成有效测试用例作为反例。本文提出测试用例扩展（Test Cases Scaling, TCS）框架，这一用于生成有效测试的两阶段强化学习框架的两个阶段均从与滚动策略对齐的缓冲区中训练测试生成器：第一阶段生成与参考解法一致的测试用例，第二阶段将缓冲区限定为当前失效模式，学习生成反例测试用例。在TACO与LiveCodeBench两个基准上的实验结果显示，TCS可同时提升pass@1指标与基于生成测试的推理时答案选择性能，经训练得到的测试生成器还可有效筛选其他大语言模型的输出结果。

title: VestigeKV: The NoPE-MLA KV Cache Carries Its Own Eviction Signal in a Vestigial Branch
title_zh: VestigeKV：基于残差分支自带驱逐信号的NoPE-MLA KV缓存机制
authors: WenJie Fan
abstract: The problem. A long-lived KV cache must be compressed before the queries that will read it exist; selection by observed attention (H2O, SnapKV) collapses there (0.00-0.33 needle retrieval on a NoPE MLA model), because a token's importance has not yet been observed. The method. On Kimi Linear, VestigeKV evicts by a query-independent signal the cache already carries: the 64-dimensional decoupled branch, a vestige of RoPE that NoPE training repurposes into a salience channel. Reading 11% of each row, it partitions the cache: the top-m rows stay in the attended tier; every other row moves -- exactly, never deleted -- to a GPU-resident archive reachable per step by a certified trigger. No training, no quantization, no weight or kernel change. Cost. Nothing measurable: retrieval holds at 1.00 under 8x and 0.92 under 32x from 8k to 65k context, zero gap to full-row selection. The attended tier is 0.25 KB of Kimi Linear's 8.1 KB per-token cache at 32x; the archive stays bit-exact and GPU-resident, with host offload as the VRAM-reclaiming variant. The recall tier -- the standard configuration -- holds 128x at 1.00. Kimi K3 is reported to use a NoPE Gated-MLA variant; if its cache layout matches, the method plausibly extends there -- we make no claim beyond the measured model. NoPE exclusivity. The identical operator on a RoPE MLA collapses to 0.08 (plain eviction: 0.42); query-independent salience itself exists only without rotation (top-1 targets span 2.3-6.7% of tokens vs. 10.2-46.8%), and query-universal exact merging is provably impossible under RoPE. All thresholds were frozen before data; 20 archived verdicts and 8 closed routes accompany the paper.
summary_zh: 【问题】长生命周期KV缓存需要在读取该缓存的查询请求生成前完成压缩，基于观测注意力的选择方案（H2O、SnapKV）在该场景下会失效：在无位置编码多头潜在注意力（NoPE-MLA）模型上的针检索任务准确率仅为0.00-0.33，原因是此时尚未观测到token的重要性。【方法】在Kimi Linear架构上，VestigeKV利用KV缓存自带的与查询无关的信号完成驱逐：即64维解耦分支，该分支是旋转位置编码（RoPE）的残差结构，在NoPE训练过程中被重新用作重要性通道。该方法仅读取每行11%的内容即可完成缓存划分：前m行保留在注意力层级，其余所有行完整迁移至GPU驻留的归档区，每步可通过认证触发器访问，无需删除任何内容。整个过程不需要额外训练、量化，也不需要修改权重或算子。【开销】性能损失几乎可忽略：上下文长度从8k扩展到65k时，8倍压缩下检索准确率保持1.00，32倍压缩下准确率为0.92，与全量行选择的性能差距为0。32倍压缩下注意力层级仅占用Kimi Linear单token 8.1KB缓存中的0.25KB，归档区保持比特精确且全程驻留GPU，也可选择将数据卸载到主机内存以回收显存。标准配置下的检索层级可实现128倍压缩下1.00的检索准确率。据报道Kimi K3采用了带门控的NoPE-MLA变体，如果其缓存布局匹配，该方法也可扩展应用，本文不对超出已测试模型的场景做额外承诺。【NoPE排他性】在RoPE-MLA模型上运行相同算子，检索准确率会降至0.08（普通驱逐方案准确率为0.42）：与查询无关的重要性信号仅在无旋转的场景下存在（top-1目标仅覆盖2.3-6.7%的token，而RoPE场景下覆盖10.2-46.8%），且可证明在RoPE约束下不存在与查询无关的精确合并操作。所有阈值均在数据收集前固定，论文附带20个归档判定结果与8条封闭测试路径。

title: Comparing Retrieval Methods for Academic Advisor Discovery: A Six-Method Study of 768 CS Faculty Profiles Across 9 US Universities
title_zh: 学术导师检索方法对比研究：基于美国9所高校768名计算机系教师档案的六方法评估
authors: Biraj Subedi
abstract: We present a comparative evaluation of six information retrieval methods for the task of academic advisor discovery: ranking CS faculty members by relevance to a graduate applicant's research interest statement. The methods span sparse lexical matching (Jaccard overlap, TF-IDF, BM25), dense semantic retrieval (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence embeddings), hybrid score fusion, and learning-to-rank. Evaluation uses a new domain-specific collection: 768 faculty profiles scraped from 9 US CS departments, with 162 graded relevance judgments (grade 0/1/2) across 5 queries representing distinct graduate student research profiles. Across all five queries, Reranked achieves the highest mean NDCG@10 (0.477, std 0.138), followed by Semantic (0.450), Hybrid (0.421), BM25 (0.406), Jaccard (0.303), and TF-IDF (0.246). After Bonferroni correction across all 15 pairwise comparisons, TF-IDF is significantly worse than BM25, Semantic, Hybrid, and Reranked; no other pairwise difference survives correction at 5 queries. A field ablation reveals that biography alone (NDCG 0.634) outperforms the full model combining biography with research area tags (0.593). A controlled experiment shows that concatenating arXiv paper abstracts reduces NDCG@10 by 0.176, motivating a late-fusion architecture. All code, scrapers, and relevance labels are released openly.
summary_zh: 本文针对学术导师发现任务（即根据研究生申请者的研究兴趣陈述对计算机系教师做相关性排序），对六种信息检索方法开展了对比评估。测试方法覆盖稀疏词法匹配（Jaccard重叠、TF-IDF、BM25）、稠密语义检索（all-MiniLM-L6-v2句嵌入）、混合分数融合与学习排序四类。评估采用新构建的领域专属数据集：从美国9所高校计算机系爬取的768份教师档案，以及对应5个代表不同研究生研究背景查询的162个人工标注相关性结果（相关性等级为0/1/2）。在全部5个查询上，重排序方法的平均NDCG@10最高（0.477，标准差0.138），其次为语义检索（0.450）、混合方法（0.421）、BM25（0.406）、Jaccard（0.303）、TF-IDF（0.246）。经Bonferroni多重比较校正后，TF-IDF的性能显著差于BM25、语义检索、混合方法与重排序方法，其余两两对比的性能差异均未通过显著性检验。特征消融实验显示，仅使用个人传记特征的模型（NDCG为0.634）性能优于传记与研究领域标签结合的全量模型（NDCG为0.593）。对照实验表明，拼接arXiv论文摘要会使NDCG@10下降0.176，该结果为后续采用晚融合架构提供了依据。本文所有代码、爬虫程序与相关性标签均已开源。

title: Beyond Endpoint Scores: Time- and Capacity-Conditioned Evaluation of Continual Knowledge Updating
title_zh: 超越端点指标：基于时间与容量条件的持续知识更新评估方法
authors: Heejin Choi
abstract: Continual knowledge-updating methods are often declared superior from one final checkpoint and one conventional adapter rank. We show that this can be insufficient to identify the better operating point. Holding a periodic hierarchy fixed, we compare it with cumulative replay over a 24-month Wikidata stream while varying evaluation month, replay LoRA rank, and query formulation. The apparent winner changes across this region: on Qwen2.5-1.5B, the hierarchy's 5.0-point advantage over rank-8 replay becomes an 11.6-point deficit against rank-72 replay, and at high ranks a consolidation-aligned endpoint can suggest a tie while time-averaged replay leads by 9-13 points. The same rank-conditioned reversal appears on Llama-3.2-1B and held-out paraphrases.These results show that method ranking in continual updating can depend jointly on when performance is measured and how much replay-side adaptation capacity the baseline receives. We therefore propose reporting trajectories and capacity sweeps, and declaring a robust winner only when the ordering is stable across the evaluation region; otherwise, comparisons should report winner regions and retention-stability-cost frontiers. Under this protocol, the periodic hierarchy is a lower-update-cost operating point, not a quality winner.
summary_zh: 现有持续知识更新方法通常仅基于单个最终检查点和一个常规适配器秩参数就判定方法优劣，本文证明该评估方式不足以识别更优的工作点。我们固定分层周期架构，在24个月的Wikidata数据流上与累积重放方法做对比，同时改变评估月份、重放LoRA秩参数与查询表述方式，发现不同场景下的最优方法会发生变化：在Qwen2.5-1.5B模型上，分层架构在秩为8的重放场景下有5.0个点的优势，但在秩为72的重放场景下反而落后11.6个点；在高秩场景下，对齐整合的端点评估结果会显示两种方法性能相当，但时间平均重放方法反而领先9-13个点。该秩参数导致的性能反转现象同样出现在Llama-3.2-1B模型与预留的复述测试集上。上述结果表明，持续更新方法的性能排序同时取决于性能测量的时间点与基线方法可获得的重放侧适配容量。因此本文建议报告性能轨迹与容量扫描结果，仅当性能排序在整个评估区域内保持稳定时才可判定某一方法为鲁棒最优，否则对比结果需要报告最优方法的适用区间与保留率-稳定性-成本帕累托前沿。在该评估协议下，周期分层架构是更新成本更低的工作点，而非性能更优的方案。

title: High-Dimensional Learning Dynamics of Attention-Indexed Models
title_zh: 注意力索引模型的高维学习动力学研究
authors: Yizhou Xu, Margarita Sagitova, Lenka Zdeborová, Florent Krzakala
abstract: Attention mechanisms are central to modern foundation models, yet their training dynamics remain poorly understood, especially when the attention matrices have extensive rank. In this work, we study attention-indexed models, a broad framework that can represent multi-layer and multi-head attention architectures. First, we show that, in a suitable high-dimensional limit, the population-loss landscape is characterized by a finite set of trace order parameters. In contrast, online stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is governed by an infinite hierarchy of matrix moments, which we show can be exponentially well-approximated by a finite truncated system. Second, this framework reveals that attention parameterization itself can act as an architectural implicit bias. Direct optimization of an attention matrix $S\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$ can remain trapped in an uninformative state. Tied attention ($S=WW^\top$) induces an automatic symmetry-breaking mechanism and yields weak recovery in $\Theta(d^2\log d)$ samples. For untied attention, $S=UV^\top$, we uncover a fast-slow mechanism: the pre-activation mean first evolves on a fast timescale, while the overlaps evolve on a slower one. Weak recovery on the $\Theta(d^2\log d)$ scale occurs when the state selected by the fast dynamics breaks the initial symmetry.
summary_zh: 注意力机制是现代大模型的核心组件，但其训练动力学特性目前仍未得到充分理解，尤其当注意力矩阵的秩较高时相关研究更为匮乏。本文研究注意力索引模型，这一可表征多层多头注意力架构的通用框架。首先我们证明，在合适的高维极限下，总体损失景观可由有限个迹序参数表征；与之相对，在线随机梯度下降（SGD）的动力学由无穷层级的矩阵矩控制，我们证明该无穷层级系统可通过有限截断系统实现指数级精度的近似。其次该框架揭示，注意力参数化本身可作为一种架构隐式偏置：直接优化注意力矩阵$S\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$可能会困在无信息的无效状态；绑定注意力（$S=WW^\top$）可触发自动对称破缺机制，仅需$\Theta(d^2\log d)$量级的样本即可实现弱恢复。对于非绑定注意力$S=UV^\top$，我们发现其存在快慢动力学机制：预激活均值首先在快时间尺度上演化，而重叠量在更慢的时间尺度上演化，当快动力学选择的状态打破初始对称性时，即可在$\Theta(d^2\log d)$量级的样本下实现弱恢复。

title: Pushing the (Decision) Boundaries: Dynamically Calibrating Differentially Private Noise to Explainability in Federated Learning
title_zh: 突破决策边界：联邦学习中面向可解释性的动态差分隐私噪声校准方法
authors: Michael Khavkin, Kichang Lee, Jaeho Jin, JeongGil Ko, Eran Toch
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) with Differential Privacy (DP) is increasingly adopted to preserve data confidentiality in distributed machine learning. However, DP noise distorts learned representations and degrades explanation fidelity, limiting differentially private FL where trustworthy explanations are required, such as assistive clinical diagnosis. Prior work adapted DP noise with static feature-importance signals, restricting explainability to post hoc analysis and precluding noise calibration to explanation quality during training.
