We propose XCal-FL, a closed-loop, explainability-driven local training algorithm for image classification in cross-silo FL that dynamically calibrates DP noise from three complementary signals: (1) prediction logit variations, measuring causal influence on model confidence, (2) counterfactual margins, capturing decision-boundary sensitivity, and (3) saliency concentration, quantifying spatial coherence of model attention, while enforcing formal DP guarantees via adaptive privacy accounting. Experiments on three medical imaging datasets across varying FL configurations show that XCal-FL yields more accurate and interpretable global models, improving predictive performance by over 10\% and explanation fidelity by up to 5$\times$ over static-noise FL, and outperforming state-of-the-art adaptive DP methods in fidelity. XCal-FL also achieves higher privacy-budget efficiency, turning each unit of cumulative privacy loss into larger gains in both accuracy and explanation fidelity. Our analysis further reveals that, unlike predictive performance, which scales roughly linearly with privacy loss, explanation fidelity exhibits non-linear dynamics. These findings suggest explainability is a distinct dimension of the privacy trade-off that cannot be inferred from utility alone, with implications for training and privacy-budget allocation in decision-critical applications.
summary_zh: 带差分隐私（DP）的联邦学习（FL）被广泛用于分布式机器学习场景下的数据隐私保护，但差分隐私噪声会扭曲学习到的表征，降低解释结果的保真度，限制了差分隐私联邦学习在需要可信解释的场景（如辅助临床诊断）中的应用。现有工作采用静态特征重要性信号调整差分隐私噪声，仅支持事后分析层面的可解释性优化，无法在训练过程中根据解释质量动态校准噪声。本文提出XCal-FL，一种面向跨孤岛联邦学习图像分类任务的闭环可解释性驱动本地训练算法，可基于三类互补信号动态校准差分隐私噪声：（1）预测logits波动，衡量对模型置信度的因果影响；（2）反事实间隔，捕捉决策边界敏感度；（3）显著性集中度，量化模型注意力的空间一致性，同时通过自适应隐私会计保障严格的差分隐私约束。在三个不同联邦学习配置的医学影像数据集上的实验表明，XCal-FL得到的全局模型准确率更高、可解释性更强，相比静态噪声联邦学习预测性能提升超过10%，解释保真度最高提升5倍，且保真度表现优于当前最先进的自适应差分隐私方法。XCal-FL还具备更高的隐私预算效率，每单位累积隐私损失可转化为更大的准确率与解释保真度增益。进一步分析表明，与随隐私损失近似线性增长的预测性能不同，解释保真度呈现非线性动力学特性，说明可解释性是隐私权衡中独立于效用的全新维度，无法仅通过效用指标推导得到，该结论可为决策关键场景下的模型训练与隐私预算分配提供参考。

title: EF1-Constrained Nash Social Welfare with Identical Additive Valuations: Complexity, Guarantees, and Experiments
title_zh: 同相加值下满足EF1约束的纳什社会福利：复杂度、性能保证与实验研究
authors: Zih-Sian Yang, Yi-Hao Chen, Yu-Te Kuan, Cheng-Jui Wu, Chuang-Chieh Lin 等 (6 人)
abstract: We study the allocation of indivisible goods among agents with identical additive valuations, focusing on envy-freeness up to one good (EF1) and Nash social welfare (NSW). Since every maximum-NSW allocation is EF1 under additive valuations, the associated threshold problem inherits the known strong NP-hardness of NSW maximization under identical additive valuations and is strongly NP-complete. We therefore focus on welfare guarantees satisfied by arbitrary EF1 allocations. Although every such allocation is known to achieve an $e^{-1/e}$-approximation to the unrestricted optimal NSW, we identify conditions yielding stronger guarantees. Under uniform valuations, every EF1 allocation is NSW-optimal. Under an $\varepsilon$-small-item condition, every EF1 allocation achieves an explicit approximation ratio $\rho_n(\varepsilon)$ satisfying $\rho_n(\varepsilon) = 1-O(\varepsilon^2)$ as $\varepsilon\to 0$ for fixed $n$.We further consider the stronger sequential requirement that EF1 be maintained after every item assignment. For this setting, we propose \emph{PriorityNet}, a deep reinforcement learning framework trained using Proximal Policy Optimization and equipped with prospective EF1 action masking. The mask restricts every decision to assignments that preserve EF1, thereby guaranteeing prefix-wise EF1 by construction without post-processing repair. Across 3,000 test instances in each of the offline and random-order online regimes ($n\in[2,20]$ and $m\in[5,100]$), PriorityNet attains mean normalized $\operatorname{NSW}$ values of $0.9911$ and $0.9701$, respectively. Relative to offline Longest Processing Time (LPT) and online least-valued-bundle baselines, it achieves instance-wise win-minus-loss rates of $+27.10\%$ and $+17.87\%$, while matching the offline baseline's mean normalized welfare to four decimal places and modestly improving the online mean from $0.9694$ to $0.9701$.
summary_zh: 本文研究同相加值的智能体之间的不可分物品分配问题，重点关注至多单物品无妒性（envy-freeness up to one good, EF1）与纳什社会福利（Nash social welfare, NSW）两个指标。由于在相加值设定下所有最大化纳什社会福利的分配方案均满足EF1，对应的阈值判定问题继承了同相加值下纳什社会福利最大化问题的强NP难度特性，属于强NP完全问题。因此本文重点研究任意EF1分配方案可满足的福利保证：尽管已知所有EF1分配方案均可获得无约束最优纳什社会福利的$e^{-1/e}$近似比，我们识别出可实现更优保证的条件：在均匀加值设定下，所有EF1分配方案均为纳什社会福利最优；在$\varepsilon$小物品条件下，所有EF1分配方案均可达到显式近似比$\rho_n(\varepsilon)$，当固定智能体数量$n$且$\varepsilon\to0$时$\rho_n(\varepsilon) = 1-O(\varepsilon^2)$。我们进一步考虑更严格的序列约束要求：每分配一件物品后分配结果都保持EF1性质。针对该场景，本文提出PriorityNet深度强化学习框架，采用近端策略优化算法训练，配备前瞻EF1动作掩码，该掩码将每一步决策限制在可保持EF1性质的分配动作范围内，可从构造层面保证所有前缀分配均满足EF1，无需后处理修复。在离线与随机顺序在线两个场景下各3000个测试实例（智能体数量$n\in[2,20]$，物品数量$m\in[5,100]$）上的测试结果显示，PriorityNet的归一化纳什社会福利均值分别达到0.9911与0.9701，相比离线最长处理时间（LPT）基线与在线最小价值束基线，逐实例的赢减输率分别高出27.10%与17.87%，离线场景下的归一化福利均值与基线持平到四位小数，在线场景下的均值从基线的0.9694小幅提升至0.9701。

title: Flip, Don't Shuffle: Watermarking LLMs at the Speed of Inference
title_zh: 翻转而非打乱：与推理速度同步的大语言模型水印方法
authors: Simone Ceppi, Ignacio Sanchez
abstract: We introduce Stateless Bernoulli Watermarking (SBW), a new statistical watermark for Large Language Models that determines green list membership through independent per-token Bernoulli trials. Unlike KGW's vocabulary permutation or SynthID's multi-layer tournament, SBW requires only a single comparison per token against a counter-based random number generator, reducing membership complexity to $O(1)$ and enabling single-kernel execution with zero intermediate allocations. We prove that this formulation preserves the same detection guarantees as fixed-size green lists: the z-score test remains $\mathcal{N}(0,1)$ under the null. The stateless architecture enables capabilities unavailable to existing methods: full-vocabulary self-salt watermarking (over 6000$\times$ faster than KGW's self-salt and 2$\times$ faster than SynthID despite biasing the entire vocabulary with candidate-dependent seeding) and architectural compatibility with distributed inference. In end-to-end generation benchmarks, SBW adds less than 1\% overhead at all batch sizes. We additionally identify hash function design as a previously unexplored axis for watermark quality, showing that a GPU-native Jenkins hash improves null calibration by 1.8$\times$ while producing more diverse text. Experiments across two seeding schemes and eight $(\gamma, \delta)$ configurations confirm statistical equivalence with ROC-AUC differences below 0.01.
summary_zh: 本文提出无状态伯努利水印（Stateless Bernoulli Watermarking, SBW），一种面向大语言模型的新型统计水印方案，通过逐token独立伯努利试验判定其是否属于绿名单。与KGW的词表排列机制或SynthID的多层锦标赛机制不同，SBW仅需针对基于计数器的随机数生成器做一次逐token比较，将绿名单判定复杂度降至$O(1)$，支持单算子执行且无需中间内存分配。我们从理论上证明该方案可保持与固定大小绿名单相同的检测保证：零假设下z分数检验仍服从$\mathcal{N}(0,1)$分布。无状态架构可实现现有水印方法不支持的特性：全词表自加盐水印（速度是KGW自加盐方案的6000倍以上，比SynthID快2倍，尽管该方案需要基于候选种子对整个词表做偏置处理），且天然兼容分布式推理场景。在端到端生成基准测试中，所有批大小下SBW引入的开销均低于1%。本文还首次将哈希函数设计作为影响水印质量的全新研究维度，实验表明GPU原生Jenkins哈希可将零假设校准精度提升1.8倍，同时生成文本的多样性更高。在两种种子方案与8组$(\gamma, \delta)$配置下的实验表明，SBW与基准水印方法的性能统计等价，ROC-AUC差异小于0.01。

title: Multi-step Proximal Policy Improvement in Offline Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 离线强化学习中的多步近端策略改进
authors: Soohyun Choi, Seonvin Cho, Songnam Hong
abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) must reconcile two competing requirements: policy updates should stay near dataset-supported actions to keep value estimates reliable, yet meaningful gains often require moving beyond the behavior distribution. We develop a geometric view of offline actor updates by modeling policies as a probability manifold endowed with a chosen metric geometry. Under this lens, a broad class of offline actor objectives can be interpreted as a single proximal policy improvement step (SPI), i.e., an implicit discretization of a manifold gradient flow induced by a critic-defined energy. Building on this insight, we propose multi-step proximal policy improvement (MPI), a plug-in refinement mechanism that composes sequential re-centered proximal steps. MPI enables controlled policy improvement beyond dataset support while retaining proximal control at each refinement. The framework accommodates multiple policy geometries and admits practical instantiations for deterministic and diagonal-Gaussian policies. Experiments on D4RL benchmarks show that small numbers of MPI refinements improve strong offline baselines, including TD3+BC, ReBRAC, and IQL, on many tasks. Focused diagnostics further distinguish re-centered refinement from fixed-objective update scheduling and characterize limitations under critic error.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习（Offline RL）必须协调两个相互冲突的要求：策略更新应保持在数据集支持的动作附近，以保证价值估计的可靠性，但有意义的性能提升通常需要超出行为分布的范围。本文通过将策略建模为配备指定度量几何的概率流形，提出了离线演员更新的几何视角。在该视角下，广泛的离线演员目标可被解释为单步近端策略改进（SPI），即由评论家网络定义的能量所诱导的流形梯度流的隐式离散化。基于这一洞见，我们提出多步近端策略改进（MPI），这是一种可即插即用的优化机制，可组合多个连续的重中心化近端步骤。MPI能够在受控条件下实现超出数据集支持范围的策略改进，同时在每一步优化中都保留近端控制能力。该框架兼容多种策略几何结构，可针对确定性策略和对角高斯策略生成实用的实例化方案。在D4RL基准测试上的实验表明，少量MPI优化即可在多项任务上提升TD3+BC、ReBRAC和IQL等现有优秀离线基线方法的性能。针对性的诊断实验进一步区分了重中心化优化与固定目标更新调度的差异，并刻画了评论家网络误差场景下该方法的局限性。

title: A Peer-Relative Representation Learning Framework for Energy Inefficiency Identification in Mobile Network Sites
title_zh: 面向移动网络站点能效低下识别的对等相对表征学习框架
authors: Eliud Nyakweba Koto, Jaco du Toit, Adham Stoltz, Johan du Preez
abstract: Energy consumption is one of the largest operational expenditure items for mobile network operators, yet site-level energy inefficiencies such as faulty cooling controllers, idle radio equipment, and parasitic auxiliary loads often remain undetected because no ground-truth inefficiency labels exist and historical measurements may already contain embedded inefficiencies. This study proposes an unsupervised peer-relative approach based on the premise that sites with similar structural and operational characteristics should exhibit comparable energy consumption. To capture these relationships, a novel energy-aware Minimum Distortion Embedding (MDE) formulation is introduced that extends the standard MDE objective with an energy-based repulsion mechanism. This encourages sites with anomalously high energy consumption relative to comparable peers to become displaced from their local neighbourhoods in the embedding space. The resulting low-dimensional representation simultaneously preserves structural similarity and encodes energy-related deviations, enabling the identification of potentially inefficient sites through peer-relative comparison. The derived anomaly scores provide a practical mechanism for prioritising field investigations, allowing mobile network operators to focus engineering resources on sites most likely to yield energy savings. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms conventional anomaly detection baselines and provides a robust foundation for large-scale energy-efficiency optimisation in mobile networks.
summary_zh: 能耗是移动网络运营商最大的运营支出项目之一，但站点级的能效低下问题（如冷却控制器故障、无线电设备空转、寄生辅助负载等）往往难以被发现，原因在于不存在能效低下的真实标注，且历史测量数据可能已经包含了内嵌的低效状态。本研究提出一种无监督的对等相对方法，其核心前提是：结构和运行特征相似的站点应当具备相近的能耗水平。为了捕捉这类关联关系，本文提出一种全新的能量感知最小失真嵌入（Minimum Distortion Embedding, MDE）公式，在标准MDE目标的基础上新增了基于能耗的排斥机制。该机制可促使与同类对等站点相比能耗异常偏高的站点在嵌入空间中偏离其局部邻域。最终得到的低维表征同时保留了站点的结构相似性，还编码了与能耗相关的偏差信息，支持通过对等相对比较识别出潜在的低效站点。生成的异常评分为现场排查优先级排序提供了实用机制，帮助移动网络运营商将工程资源集中在最有可能实现节能的站点上。实验结果表明，所提方法的性能优于传统异常检测基线，可为移动网络的大规模能效优化提供可靠基础。

title: From Ordered Bernoulli Levels to Critical-Line Geometry: Integer Quantization, Bernoulli Residual Phase, and Prime-Power Spectra
title_zh: 从有序伯努利能级到临界线几何：整数量化、伯努利残差相位与素数幂谱
authors: Y. Kenan Yılmaz
abstract: We study the ordered Bernoulli-word kernel f(p,n,k)=p^k(1-p)^(n-k) and the geometry generated by its inverse-integer level sets. The binary level 2^(-n) selects p=1/2 as the unique real split-independent anchor. Under complement-preserving complex continuation, the pair becomes z=1/2+iu and 1-z=1/2-iu, producing a conjugation-symmetric vertical geometry before any zeta-function input is introduced. The quadratic coordinate Q(z)=z(1-z)=1/4+u^2 has a sharp minimum at the central point and admits an exact integer quantization. For critical-line zero ordinates gamma_k, the induced levels L_k=1/4+gamma_k^2 are decomposed exactly as L_k=N_k+delta_k, where N_k is the nearest integer and delta_k is a periodic first-Bernoulli residual. Circularization gives Z_k=exp(2 pi i delta_k), isolating gamma_k^2 mod 1 as the residual phase variable. Unique factorization resolves the integer shells into prime-generator coordinates, while a distinct complex exponent s lifts the same construction to the Dirichlet atoms m^(-s), linking the Dirichlet-series and Euler-product assemblies. Exact identities, classical zeta connections, numerical controls, and open conditional Weyl tests are kept explicitly separate. No proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is claimed.
summary_zh: 本文研究有序伯努利词核f(p,n,k)=p^k(1-p)^(n-k)及其逆整数水平集生成的几何结构。二进制水平2^(-n)将p=1/2选为唯一的与分裂无关的实锚点。在保持补集不变的复延拓操作下，该点对变为z=1/2+iu和1-z=1/2-iu，在引入任何ζ函数输入之前就生成了共轭对称的垂直几何结构。二次坐标Q(z)=z(1-z)=1/4+u^2在中心点处存在尖锐最小值，可实现精确的整数量化。对于临界线零点的纵坐标γ_k，诱导能级L_k=1/4+γ_k^2可被精确分解为L_k=N_k+δ_k，其中N_k是最近整数，δ_k是周期性的一阶伯努利残差。通过圆化操作得到Z_k=exp(2πiδ_k)，可将γ_k² mod 1分离为残差相位变量。唯一分解性质可将整数壳层分解为素数生成器坐标，而独特的复指数s可将同一构造提升至狄利克雷原子m^(-s)，建立狄利克雷级数与欧拉积结构的关联。本文将精确恒等式、经典ζ函数关联、数值控制实验和开放的条件外尔检验明确区分开，并未提出黎曼假设的相关证明。

title: Landmark-Based Discrimination of Injury-Associated Athlete-Sessions from Minute-Resolution Multimodal Football Monitoring Data
title_zh: 基于地标从分钟级多模态足球监测数据中识别与损伤相关的运动员训练单元
authors: Evangelos Chatzidimitriou, Konstantinos Tserpes
abstract: Athlete monitoring data may be recorded minute by minute throughout a match or training session, while injury information may only indicate whether the entire session was injury-associated.This creates a modelling problem: assigning the same session-level label to every minute would imply that injury status is known at each exact time, even though within-session injury onset is unknown.Our novelty is a fixed-landmark, one-representation-per-athlete-session formulation that directly addresses this mismatch. Instead of labelling every minute, we construct one representation per athlete-session at each landmark using information observed up to that point. This keeps the target at the session level and avoids unsupported minute-level injury supervision.A landmark is a fixed time point within the same session, such as 10, 20, or 30 minutes. At each landmark, we assess whether the whole session is injury-associated or non-injury-associated and examine how discrimination changes as more within-session information becomes available.Using 2020 SoccerMon data, we analyse 3,743 athlete-sessions from 48 elite women's football athletes, including 22 injury-associated sessions from five athletes. We evaluate pre-session, cumulative, dynamic, and combined representations with athlete-disjoint validation, athlete-cluster bootstrap uncertainty, common-cohort sensitivity analysis, alternative negative-athlete fold allocations, equal-athlete weighting, and Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost benchmarks.Primary CUM+DYN Logistic Regression yields ROC-AUC 0.367-0.607 and PR-AUC 0.0080-0.0150 across landmarks, with wide uncertainty. PRE-containing representations show higher point estimates at several landmarks but remain uncertain.
summary_zh: 运动员监测数据可在整场比赛或训练过程中按分钟记录，但损伤信息通常仅能标注整个训练单元是否与损伤相关。这就带来了建模难题：如果将同一训练单元级别的标签分配给每一分钟数据，就相当于默认损伤发生的精确时间点已知，但实际上训练单元内的损伤起始时间是未知的。本文提出一种固定地标、每个运动员训练单元对应一个表征的建模框架，直接解决上述标签不匹配问题。我们无需为每一分钟数据标注，而是在每个地标时刻利用截至该时刻的观测信息为每个运动员训练单元构建一个表征，将预测目标保持在训练单元层面，避免了缺乏支撑的分钟级损伤监督需求。地标指同一训练单元内的固定时间点，例如第10、20、30分钟。在每个地标时刻，我们评估整个训练单元是否与损伤相关，并分析随着单元内可获取信息的增加，模型的区分能力会发生何种变化。基于2020年SoccerMon数据集，我们分析了48名精英女子足球运动员的3743个训练单元，其中包含来自5名运动员的22个损伤相关单元。我们采用运动员互斥验证、运动员集群自举不确定性分析、同队列敏感性分析、替代负样本运动员折分配、等运动员加权等方法，对赛前表征、累积表征、动态表征和组合表征进行评估，基线模型采用逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost。最优的CUM+DYN逻辑回归模型在各地标处的ROC-AUC为0.367~0.607，PR-AUC为0.0080~0.0150，不确定性范围较大。包含PRE模块的表征在多个地标处的点估计值更高，但结果仍存在不确定性。

title: OBER+: Continuity-Aware Reporting and Traceable Continuous Improvement in Outcome-Based Education
title_zh: OBER+: 成果导向教育中的连续性感知报告与可追溯持续改进
authors: Elakkiya Rajasekar
abstract: Institutions practising outcome-based education compute learning outcome attainment routinely, while reviews of curriculum analytics report an absence of evidence on how that computation informs decisions. This paper presents OBER+, an extension of a deployed institutional attainment platform that computes the step from a measured shortfall to an evaluated corrective action. Five connected stages accumulate attainment across deliveries of a course, signal a shortfall and a persistent shortfall, grade it on cutoffs the regulator already uses, record the decision against a catalogue of practices annotated with their evidence, log the change, and quantify the subsequent movement in the shortfall. A further rule compares successive statements of an outcome, so attainment is never read as a series across a point at which the outcome changed. Applying the rules to the live record of two real courses produced three results. Every outcome of a core course was substantively redefined between consecutive deliveries, with subject matter moving between outcome numbers, so a naive reading would have reported a twenty-five point collapse between quantities that do not refer to the same learning. Recomputing the platform's figures from its documented rule showed six of ten differing by more than rounding explains, in a pattern that identified a defect since reported to the institution. Across fifteen statement pairs from three transitions, five were identical character for character, and among the ten that were not, the outcome carrying a given number was nearest to a differently numbered earlier outcome in six, a result resting on an ordering of similarities and requiring no threshold and no labelling. The contribution is a computational design for outcome-based reporting, stated as rules any attainment platform can implement, with evidence of what they make visible in a live institutional record.
summary_zh: 开展成果导向教育的院校通常会定期计算学习成果的达成度，但课程分析相关综述指出，目前尚无证据表明这类计算能够为决策提供信息。本文提出OBER+，这是一套已部署的院校达成度平台的扩展系统，可实现从测量得到的达成度缺口到评估后纠正措施的全流程计算。系统包含5个关联阶段：累计多轮课程交付的达成度数据、识别达成度缺口和持续性缺口、按照监管机构已使用的截断值对缺口进行分级、对照标注了证据的实践目录记录决策内容、记录变更信息并量化后续缺口的变化幅度。另有一条规则用于比对同一学习成果的不同版本描述，确保不会在学习成果定义发生变更的时间点前后将达成度数据作为连续序列读取。将上述规则应用于两门真实课程的历史数据后得到三项结果：第一，一门核心课程的所有学习成果在连续两轮交付过程中都进行了实质性重定义，知识点在不同成果编号之间发生了转移，如果采用朴素读取方式，会误报两个不指向同一学习内容的指标之间出现25分的大幅下跌。第二，根据平台记录的规则重新计算指标后发现，10个指标中有6个的差异超出了舍入误差可解释的范围，该模式识别出的缺陷已被上报至相关院校。第三，在3次版本迭代生成的15组成果描述对中，有5组完全一致，剩余10组中编号对应的学习成果与更早的不同编号成果相似度最高，该结果基于相似度排序得到，无需设置阈值也无需人工标注。本文的贡献在于提出了一套成果导向报告的计算设计，以所有达成度平台均可实现的规则形式呈现，并提供了相关证据说明该规则可在真实院校数据中挖掘出此前不可见的信息。

title: From Nowcasting to Forecasting: Adapting a Reanalysis-Trained
title_zh: 从临近预报到预报：适配经再分析训练的模型
authors: Mikko Partio, Leila Hieta, Ossi Laine
abstract: Accurate cloud-cover forecasts are important for temperature prediction, radiation forecasting, and solar-power operations. Short-range forecasting methods can preserve observed cloud placement during the first forecast hours, but their skill decreases when cloud fields evolve through formation, dissipation and deformation. Longer lead times require accounting for atmospheric evolution, but operational numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts may not accurately represent the satellite-observed cloud state at initialization. We develop CloudCast v2, a machine-learning model for 12-hour cloud-cover forecasting from observation-based initial conditions. The model is first trained on the Copernicus European Regional Reanalysis (Ridal2024) to learn cloud-evolution dynamics, and is then adapted to satellite-derived cloud fields using conditional flow matching (Lipman2023), a generative method that transforms noise into cloud-cover forecasts conditioned on the observed initial cloud fields and NWP inputs. CloudCast v2 reduces mean absolute error by 10% relative to its predecessor, CloudCast v1 (Partio2025), over the 1-12 h range. It also overtakes CloudCast v1 in fractions skill score, a neighborhood-based measure of spatial agreement, after approximately 3-6 h, depending on the cloudiness category. These results show that observation-initialized machine-learning forecasts can extend beyond the usual 1-3-hour nowcasting range while retaining spatial detail from satellite cloud fields.
summary_zh: 高精度云量预报对温度预测、辐射预报和太阳能发电运营至关重要。短临预报方法可在预报初始数小时内保留观测到的云位置信息，但当云场经历形成、消散和形变过程时，其预报性能会出现下降。更长的预报时效需要考虑大气演化过程，但业务化数值天气预报（Numerical Weather Prediction, NWP）预报可能无法准确表示初始化时刻卫星观测到的云状态。本文提出CloudCast v2，这是一款基于观测初始条件实现12小时云量预报的机器学习模型。该模型首先在哥白尼欧洲区域再分析数据集（Ridal2024）上训练以学习云演化动力学，随后使用条件流匹配（Lipman2023）适配卫星反演云场，这是一种生成式方法，可基于观测到的初始云场和NWP输入将噪声转换为云量预报结果。与前代模型CloudCast v1（Partio2025）相比，CloudCast v2在1~12小时预报区间内的平均绝对误差降低了10%。在3~6小时之后（具体时长取决于云类别），CloudCast v2的邻域空间一致性度量——分数技能得分也超过了CloudCast v1。上述结果表明，基于观测初始化的机器学习预报可突破传统1~3小时临近预报的范围，同时保留卫星云场的空间细节信息。

title: Projected Riemannian Gradient Descent for the Bures-Wasserstein Barycenter: Dimension-Independent Linear Convergence at Unit Step Size
title_zh: 用于Bures-Wasserstein重心的投影黎曼梯度下降：单位步长下与维度无关的线性收敛
authors: A. Afham
abstract: The computation of the Bures-Wasserstein (BW) barycenter of an ensemble of positive definite matrices arises throughout machine learning, optimal transport, and quantum information. Riemannian gradient descent (RGD) at unit step size -- the fixed-point iteration used in practice -- converges rapidly, yet existing analyses present a dichotomy: unit-step guarantees carry worst-case exponential dependence on the dimension, while dimension-independent guarantees require small step sizes that forfeit the empirical speed. We resolve this dichotomy, not by improving the guarantees for unit-step RGD, but by proposing a Projected RGD algorithm that achieves dimension-independent linear convergence at unit step size. The achieved rate, $(1 - \kappa^{-3/2})$, where $\kappa$ is the condition number of the ensemble, also polynomially improves on the best small-step guarantee ($\kappa^{3/2}$ versus $\kappa^{5/2}$ iteration complexity). The crux is a novel Projection Lemma: clipping the eigenvalues of a positive matrix to an interval $[\alpha, \beta]$ is the closed-form, non-expansive (1-Lipschitz) BW-metric projection onto the set $\{S : \alpha I \leq S \leq \beta I\}$ -- a statement which, unlike its known one-sided counterpart, does not follow from convexity. The projection is moreover free: it reuses an eigendecomposition the next iteration must perform in any case, so the projected and unprojected iterations cost the same per step. The same analysis covers the invariant matrix projection problem of Brahmachari et al. (2025), whose fixed-point algorithm we identify as unit-step RGD on a totally geodesic submanifold, thereby extending the dimension-independent guarantee to that setting verbatim.
summary_zh: 正定矩阵集合的Bures-Wasserstein（BW）重心计算广泛应用于机器学习、最优传输和量子信息领域。实际使用中采用单位步长的黎曼梯度下降（Riemannian Gradient Descent, RGD）不动点迭代收敛速度很快，但现有分析存在矛盾：单位步长的收敛保证在最坏情况下对维度呈指数依赖，而与维度无关的收敛保证要求使用小步长，牺牲了实际运行速度。本文解决了这一矛盾：我们没有改进单位步长RGD的收敛保证，而是提出一种投影黎曼梯度下降算法，在单位步长下实现了与维度无关的线性收敛。算法的收敛速率为(1-κ^(-3/2))，其中κ是矩阵集合的条件数，其迭代复杂度为κ^(3/2)，相比现有最优小步长保证的κ^(5/2)实现了多项式级提升。算法的核心是提出了全新的投影引理：将正定矩阵的特征值裁剪到区间[α, β]是BW度量下针对集合{S: αI ≤ S ≤ βI}的闭式、非扩张（1-利普希茨）投影，该结论与已知的单侧对应结论不同，无法直接从凸性推导得到。此外该投影操作几乎没有额外成本：它复用了下一次迭代必须执行的特征分解结果，因此投影迭代和非投影迭代的单步计算成本完全相同。本文的分析同样适用于Brahmachari等人（2025）提出的不变矩阵投影问题，我们证明其不动点算法是全测地子流形上的单位步长RGD，因此本文的与维度无关的收敛保证可直接推广到该场景。

title: Genetic Algorithms for Tractable Bayesian Network Fusion via Pre-Fusion Edge Pruning
title_zh: 基于预融合边剪枝的可实现贝叶斯网络融合遗传算法
authors: Pablo Torrijos, José A. Gámez, José M. Puerta, Juan A. Aledo
abstract: Bayesian Network (BN) fusion combines multiple input networks into a single structure, balancing dependency preservation with computational tractability. While unrestricted fusion retains all dependencies, it often results in overly complex networks with high treewidth, which affects inference scalability. Limited fusion mitigates this by pruning edges to control treewidth but risks overfitting to input-specific noise and omitting dependencies from the original BNs. This paper introduces a consensus framework that prioritizes shared structures among input networks while enforcing treewidth constraints, ensuring a good consensus. We propose genetic algorithms with advanced initialization, specialized operators, and a tailored fitness function. Additionally, we adapt existing methods to this problem and implement greedy baselines for benchmarking and further optimization. Experiments on synthetic and real-world BNs show the superiority of the proposed genetic algorithms over the adapted methods and greedy baselines.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯网络（Bayesian Network, BN）融合将多个输入网络合并为单个结构，需要在依赖关系保留度和计算可处理性之间取得平衡。无约束融合可保留所有依赖关系，但通常会生成树宽过高的复杂网络，影响推理的可扩展性。受限融合通过剪枝边来控制树宽，但存在过拟合输入特有噪声、遗漏原始BN中依赖关系的风险。本文提出一种共识框架，优先保留输入网络之间的共享结构，同时强制执行树宽约束，确保得到高质量的融合结果。我们提出采用高级初始化、专用算子和定制适应度函数的遗传算法，同时将现有方法适配到该问题场景，实现贪心基线方法用于基准测试和进一步优化。在合成和真实BN数据集上的实验结果表明，所提遗传算法的性能优于适配后的现有方法和贪心基线方法。

title: Federated Causal Discovery via Regression-Directed Cumulants
title_zh: 基于回归导向累积量的联邦因果发现
authors: Pablo Torrijos, Fabio Stella, José A. Gámez, José M. Puerta
abstract: In this paper we study linear non-Gaussian acyclic models (LiNGAM) when used in federated environments. These causal models allow one to go beyond Markov equivalence. However, in many domains data are scarce, and increasing the sample size by centralising data from different clients is not advisable due to regulations such as the GDPR. The federated environment offers an attractive option to balance privacy and causal discovery accuracy. Unfortunately, the standard centralised estimator in the LiNGAM setting, i.e., DirectLiNGAM, cannot be straightforwardly federated. Higher-order cumulant tensors offer a way around this obstacle: they depend only on the joint distribution of the variables involved and add exactly across independent sample groups, so a single communication round suffices in horizontal, vertical, and hybrid partitions.However, FedISHC, i.e., the current federated method along these lines, breaks down under near-symmetric noise. To overcome the above limitation, we introduce the FedRCD family of causal discovery algorithms, and investigate three variants that trade off communication rounds against algebraic noise; two of them are exact federated counterparts of the centralised high-order cumulant (HC) and HC-LiNGAM algorithms, and the single-round variants further effectively support exact unlearning at any granularity, from a single observation to a whole client. Numerical experiments show that at sample sizes typical of real deployments, the entire cumulant-based federated family does not actually rank variables by the population asymmetry that the scores encode at zero. It ranks them by a variance ladder induced by the DAG along its directed paths, the cumulant counterpart of varsortability. Marginal standardisation collapses every cumulant method to near-random ordering, while scale-invariant DirectLiNGAM, not federable under this protocol, is unaffected.
summary_zh: 本文研究联邦环境下的线性非高斯无环模型（Linear Non-Gaussian Acyclic Models, LiNGAM），这类因果模型可突破马尔可夫等价类的限制。但在很多领域数据稀缺，受通用数据保护条例（GDPR）等法规限制，无法通过聚合不同客户端的数据提升样本量，联邦环境为平衡隐私保护和因果发现精度提供了可行方案。但LiNGAM场景下的标准集中式估计器DirectLiNGAM无法直接扩展到联邦场景。高阶累积量张量可解决这一难题：它仅依赖于所涉变量的联合分布，且可在独立样本组间精确求和，因此在水平、垂直和混合数据分区场景下仅需单轮通信即可完成计算。但现有基于该思路的联邦方法FedISHC在近对称噪声场景下会失效。为克服该局限，本文提出FedRCD系列因果发现算法，研究了三种可在通信轮次和代数噪声之间做权衡的变体：其中两种是集中式高阶累积量（HC）和HC-LiNGAM算法的精确联邦对应版本，单轮变体还支持从单条观测到整个客户端任意粒度的精确遗忘操作。数值实验表明，在真实部署场景的典型样本量下，整个基于累积量的联邦算法族实际上并非按照分数在零点处编码的总体不对称性对变量排序，而是按照有向无环图沿有向路径诱导的方差阶梯排序，这是累积量版本的变量可排序性。边际标准化操作会导致所有累积量方法的排序结果接近随机，而无法在该协议下实现联邦的尺度不变DirectLiNGAM则不受影响。

title: Resolution-Aware Experimental Design under Partial Identifiability
title_zh: 部分可识别性下的分辨率感知实验设计
authors: Sofianos Panagiotis Fotias
abstract: Experimental design is commonly framed as choosing the experiment expected to provide the most information. Under partial identifiability however, persistent nuisance uncertainty can make the same observation carry different structural meanings. We introduce Resolution-Aware Experimental Design (RAED), which selects an experiment by the smallest expected nonempty structural candidate set achievable subject to false-exclusion control. We prove an exact cross-nuisance aliasing separation: an experiment can be preferred by structural and full-latent information gain, average classification, and nuisance-marginalized informativeness while having arbitrarily poorer valid structural resolution. RAED nevertheless preserves the expected ordering under a genuine composite Blackwell comparison. To make this criterion operational, we develop a learned score-based implementation with finite-sample nuisance-average and positive-tail calibration, and characterize a rare-tail sample-complexity obstruction. Under constrained sensing, two subsurface-flow benchmarks exhibit genuine RAED--expected-information-gain (EIG) experiment-selection disagreements, with the clearest and largest held-out resolution differences in WCA. In a fluvial benchmark, tail protection changes the selected physical experiment and replaces hard-region false exclusions primarily with explicit ambiguity. In a mechanistic methane-oxidation benchmark, a prospectively specified 5\% false-exclusion tolerance also yields a nontrivial finite-sample population guarantee for tail-sensitive nuisance risk, with 95\% joint confidence across all three structural families.
summary_zh: 实验设计通常被定义为选择预期可提供最多信息的实验。但在部分可识别性场景下，持续存在的冗余不确定性可能导致同一观测结果具备不同的结构含义。本文提出分辨率感知实验设计（Resolution-Aware Experimental Design, RAED），该方法在控制错误排除率的前提下，选择可实现最小非空结构候选集的实验。我们证明了精确的跨冗余混叠分离性质：部分实验在结构信息增益、全潜在信息增益、平均分类精度和冗余边缘化信息量等指标上表现更优，但有效结构分辨率可能差得多。不过RAED在符合复合布莱克韦尔比较规则的场景下仍能保留预期排序。为了让该准则可落地，我们开发了基于学习得分的实现方案，具备有限样本下的冗余平均校准和正尾校准特性，同时刻画了罕见尾场景下的样本复杂度障碍。在约束感知场景下，两个地下流基准测试显示RAED与期望信息增益（Expected Information Gain, EIG）的实验选择结果存在真实差异，其中WCA数据集上的留出分辨率差异最为显著。在河流基准测试中，尾保护机制会改变最终选择的物理实验，将硬区域的错误排除操作替换为明确的歧义标注。在甲烷氧化机制基准测试中，预先设定的5%错误排除容忍度可在三类结构族上提供95%联合置信度的有限样本总体尾敏感冗余风险保证。

title: Extracting Forgotten Prompts from Targeted Unlearned Models
title_zh: 从目标化机器遗忘模型中提取已遗忘提示词
authors: Au Ashley Hoi-Ting, Meghdad Kurmanji, William F. Shen, Nicholas D. Lane, Ligang He
abstract: Recent unlearning methods (e.g. NPO, DPO, LUNAR) make use of refusal alignment to suppress forgotten data. However, it has been shown that refusal responses might leave traces of unlearning, and recent attacks have been able to successfully recover some of the unlearned knowledge. In this paper, we uncover a new vulnerability. Existing attacks typically assume that the forgotten prompts are already known to the adversary and focus on recovering their answers. However, we show that the forgotten prompts themselves can be extracted by using the retained data and black-box access to the model. Our attack, Targeted Active Search (TAS), first identifies the forgotten entities by constructing canonical templates and entity pool, and selectively querying the model using the most informative template-entity pair under a limited query budget. Once the entities are identified, TAS instantiates prompt templates with those entities to probe the unlearned model and reconstruct the forgotten prompts. Experiments across three unlearning methods with three datasets and three LLMs shows that TAS recovers the forgotten entity with $100\%$ accuracy and reconstructs up to $95\%$ of forgotten prompts, all while using up to $99.7\%$ fewer queries than naive probing.
summary_zh: 现有机器遗忘方法（如NPO、DPO、LUNAR）利用拒绝对齐机制抑制待遗忘数据。但已有研究表明，拒答响应可能会留下机器遗忘操作的痕迹，近期的攻击手段已能够成功恢复部分被遗忘的知识。本文揭示了一类新的漏洞：现有攻击通常假设攻击者已经掌握待提取的遗忘提示，仅聚焦于恢复这些提示对应的回答。本文证明，仅利用保留数据和模型的黑盒访问权限，就可以直接提取出遗忘提示本身。我们提出的攻击方法目标主动搜索（Targeted Active Search, TAS）首先通过构建标准模板和实体池，在有限查询预算下选择信息增益最高的模板-实体对进行选择性查询，识别出所有遗忘实体；识别完成后，TAS用这些实体实例化提示模板探测被遗忘模型，最终重建出完整的遗忘提示。在3种机器遗忘方法、3个数据集和3个大语言模型上开展的实验表明，TAS恢复遗忘实体的准确率达到100%，最多可重建95%的遗忘提示，相比朴素探测方法最多可减少99.7%的查询量。

title: Relative Prime Factorization and Finite-State Presentations under Fixed Finite-Monoid Observation
title_zh: 固定有限幺半群观测下的相对素因子分解与有限状态表示
authors: Takayuki Kuriyama
abstract: Let $L\subseteq\Sigma^*$ and fix a morphism $h:\Sigma^*\to M$ into a finite monoid. We study exact factorization and canonical presentation in the relative syntactic congruence $\theta_{L,h}:=\equiv_L\cap\ker h$.We separate unique factorization from finite direct presentation. An exhaustively computer-checked $36$-element quotient has a unique exact prime factorization for every live non-unit class, yet its valid prime-return rules contain an infinite family, so unique factorization does not imply the finite relative presentation property (FRP), even for a finite quotient. We lift the same defect to a nonregular context-free language with an infinite relative quotient and finite prime spectrum.To isolate the obstruction, we introduce the finite-state relative presentation property (FSRP), in which canonical valid right-hand-side languages are represented by finite residual controllers, and prove $\mathrm{FRP}\subsetneq\mathrm{FSRP}$. We then introduce prime-target left-division determinism (PTLD), which implies unique exact factorization, tail exactness, tail determinism, and a quadratic bound on valid rules. A nonregular deterministic context-free example with a finite group observer satisfies PTLD while lying outside every fixed $(k,\ell)$-substitutable class. Finally, for fixed $h$ we give a strong positive-data learner for the canonical PTLD presentation with polynomial-time hypothesis updates and a finite characteristic sample, together with a limit reconstruction of the canonical FSRP controller from weakly behaviorally correct CFG-valued learners.
summary_zh: 设语言$L\subseteq\Sigma^*$，固定态射$h:\Sigma^*\to M$指向有限幺半群$M$，本文研究相对句法同余$\theta_{L,h}:=\equiv_L\cap\ker h$下的精确因子分解与标准表示问题。我们将唯一因子分解性质与有限直接表示性质进行了区分：经计算机全量校验的36元素商半群中，每个有效非单位类都存在唯一的精确素因子分解，但其有效素返回规则包含无穷族，这说明即使对于有限商半群，唯一因子分解也不蕴含有限相对表示性质（Finite Relative Presentation Property, FRP）。我们将该缺陷推广到具有无穷相对商和有限素谱的非正则上下文无关语言。为分离该障碍，本文引入有限状态相对表示性质（Finite-State Relative Presentation Property, FSRP），其中标准有效右侧语言由有限剩余控制器表示，并证明$\mathrm{FRP}\subsetneq\mathrm{FSRP}$。随后我们提出素目标左除确定性（Prime-Target Left-Division Determinism, PTLD），该性质可推导出唯一精确因子分解、尾部精确性、尾部确定性以及有效规则的二次上界。存在带有限群观测器的非正则确定上下文无关语言示例满足PTLD，但不属于任意固定$(k,\ell)$可替换类。最后针对固定态射$h$，我们给出了标准PTLD表示的强正数据学习器，具备多项式时间假设更新能力和有限特征样本，同时实现了从弱行为正确的CFG值学习器中对标准FSRP控制器的极限重构。

title: Residual neural networks overcome the curse of dimensionality for semilinear heat equations
title_zh: 残差神经网络克服半线性热方程的维数灾难
authors: Ilkhom Mukhammadiev, Diyora Salimova
abstract: Rigorous results show that feedforward neural networks can overcome the curse of dimensionality in the numerical approximation of high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs), but comparatively little is known about residual neural networks (ResNets) in the nonlinear PDE setting. We prove that ResNets overcome the curse of dimensionality in the numerical approximation of solutions of semilinear heat equations with globally Lipschitz continuous, gradient-independent nonlinearities: under polynomial growth and network approximability hypotheses on the PDE data, there exist $\eta\in(0,\infty)$ and ResNets $\Psi_{d,\varepsilon}$, $d\in\mathbb{N}$, $\varepsilon\in(0,1]$, with at most $\eta d^{\eta}\varepsilon^{-\eta}$ parameters whose realizations approximate the solution in dimension $d$ with an $L^2$-error of at most $\varepsilon$. The proof represents one deterministic realization of a multilevel Picard estimator by a ResNet whose shortcut connections transmit the spatial variable and a scalar accumulator, while the residual branches successively add the summands of the estimator. For ridge-sum initial conditions, admissible sigmoidal activations, and globally Lipschitz truncations of the nonlinearity, we obtain, for every $\xi>0$, the explicit bound $C_\xi d^{4+\xi}\varepsilon^{-(3+\xi)}$ on the number of parameters.
summary_zh: 已有严格理论结果证明，前馈神经网络在高维偏微分方程（Partial Differential Equations, PDEs）的数值近似中可以克服维数灾难，但目前关于残差神经网络（Residual Neural Networks, ResNets）在非线性PDE场景下的相关研究还十分匮乏。本文证明，针对全局利普希茨连续、梯度无关的非线性项构成的半线性热方程，残差神经网络在其解的数值近似过程中可以克服维数灾难：在PDE数据满足多项式增长和网络可近似性假设的前提下，存在常数$\eta\in(0,\infty)$和残差网络$\Psi_{d,\varepsilon}$（$d\in\mathbb{N}$，$\varepsilon\in(0,1]$），其参数量不超过$\eta d^{\eta}\varepsilon^{-\eta}$，对应的网络实现可以在维度$d$下以不超过$\varepsilon$的$L^2$误差近似方程解。证明过程用残差网络表示多层皮卡估计器的某一确定性实现：残差网络的快捷连接传输空间变量和标量累加器，残差分支依次累加估计器的各个求和项。针对岭和初始条件、可接受的S型激活函数、非线性项的全局利普希茨截断场景，对任意$\xi>0$，我们得到参数量的显式上界$C_\xi d^{4+\xi}\varepsilon^{-(3+\xi)}$。

title: Neural-Network Maxent: a general extension with learned nonlinearity, applied to time-series for Desert Locust distribution modelling
title_zh: 神经网络最大熵：具备可学习非线性的通用扩展，应用于沙漠蝗分布建模时序数据
authors: Alessandro Grassi, Edoardo Kimani Bellotto, Wassim El Azami, Sabrina Outmani, Maximilien Houel
abstract: Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) is essential for understanding how environmental conditions shape biodiversity, particularly for destructive pests such as the Desert Locust (Schistocerca gregaria), whose breeding dynamics are tightly coupled to rapidly evolving environmental conditions. Maxent has become the dominant method for presence-only data, but its reliance on a linear combination of hand chosen feature transforms limits its ability to capture the nonlinear, temporal relationships common in ecological monitoring, where covariates such as precipitation, soil moisture, and vegetation indices evolve meaningfully over time. Standard implementations flatten time-series covariates into independent features, discarding sequential structure that carries critical signal. We introduce RNN Maxent, an extension of the Maxent framework that replaces the fixed feature dictionary with a neural network, specifically a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), trained end to end via backpropagation. The approach preserves Maxent's presence only statistical foundations, background normalization, and probability calibration, differing only in that the nonlinearity is learned from data rather than fixed in advance. We apply RNN Maxent to map suitable habitat for the Desert Locust using 50 day environmental time series derived from ERA5 Land, MODIS, and Sentinel 3, maintaining a 7 day gap between covariates and presence records to yield forecasting behavior. Compared against standard Maxent, RNN Maxent improves performance across metrics (ROC AUC 0.862 std 0.036 vs. 0.792; F1 0.671 std 0.056 vs. 0.590).
summary_zh: 物种分布建模（Species Distribution Modelling, SDM）是理解环境条件塑造生物多样性机制的核心手段，对于沙漠蝗（Schistocerca gregaria）这类繁殖动态与快速变化的环境条件高度耦合的破坏性害虫尤为重要。最大熵模型（Maxent）是仅存在数据场景下的主流方法，但该方法依赖人工选择特征变换的线性组合，难以捕捉生态监测中普遍存在的非线性时序关系——生态监测中的降水、土壤湿度、植被指数等协变量会随时间发生显著变化。传统Maxent的标准实现会将时序协变量展平为独立特征，丢弃了携带关键信号的序列结构。本文提出RNN Maxent，作为Maxent框架的扩展，用神经网络（具体为门控循环单元Gated Recurrent Unit, GRU）替换固定特征字典，通过反向传播实现端到端训练。该方法保留了Maxent仅存在数据的统计基础、背景归一化机制和概率校准能力，仅将原本预先固定的非线性替换为从数据中学习得到的非线性。我们利用ERA5陆面数据、MODIS、Sentinel 3生成的50天环境时序数据，将RNN Maxent应用于沙漠蝗适宜生境制图，协变量和存在记录之间设置7天间隔以实现预测能力。与标准Maxent相比，RNN Maxent的各项指标均有提升：ROC AUC从0.792（标准差0.036）提升至0.862，F1值从0.590（标准差0.056）提升至0.671。

title: Correlated initialization of deep residual networks
title_zh: 深度残差网络的相关初始化
authors: Felix Benning, Ivan Nourdin, Giovanni Peccati
abstract: We study the large-depth behavior of residual networks whose weights are correlated across layers at initialization. Our results confirm and extend a conjecture of Marion et al. [2025], according to which correlated initializations should interpolate continuously between the Brownian stochastic differential equation arising from independent initialization and the ordinary differential equation arising from perfectly correlated initialization.When the initialization is obtained from the application of a feature function to a stationary Gaussian sequence with regularly varying correlation, we prove that there exists a unique critical scaling such that the infinite-depth limit is the solution of a Young differential equation driven by a Hermite process. Hermite processes reduce to the fractional Brownian motion if the feature function generating the initialization has Hermite rank one, which is the case for the identity function, for example. We show that the critical scaling and asymptotic limit are uniquely determined by the decay of correlations together with the Hermite rank of the feature function. Consequently, the correlation structure and Hermite rank of the initialization represent meaningful hyperparameters in the asymptotic regime. By contrast, under finite-variance iid initialization, the asymptotic driver is universally Brownian up to normalization regardless of the choice of distribution.Our proofs rely on a collection of novel results establishing a robust stability theory for Young differential equations in Banach spaces.
summary_zh: 本文研究初始化时跨层权重存在相关性的残差网络的大深度行为。研究结果验证并拓展了Marion et al. [2025]提出的猜想：相关初始化可以在独立初始化对应的布朗随机微分方程和完全相关初始化对应的常微分方程之间实现连续插值。当初始化由特征函数作用于具有正则变化相关性的平稳高斯序列生成时，我们证明存在唯一的临界缩放规则，使得无限深度极限是由Hermite过程驱动的Young微分方程的解；当生成初始化的特征函数的Hermite秩为1时，Hermite过程退化为分数布朗运动，恒等函数就是这类特征函数的典型示例。我们证明临界缩放和渐近极限完全由相关性的衰减特性和特征函数的Hermite秩唯一决定，因此初始化的相关结构和Hermite秩是渐近场景下的有效超参数。与之形成对比的是，在有限方差独立同分布初始化下，无论选择何种分布，归一化后的渐近驱动项都统一为布朗运动。本文的证明依赖于一系列新结论，这些结论建立了Banach空间上Young微分方程的鲁棒稳定性理论。

title: WeatherNext 3: Increasing resolution and performance of global weather models with raw observations
title_zh: WeatherNext 3：利用原始观测提升全球气象模型的分辨率与性能
authors: Stephan Rasp, Boris Babenko, Dominic Masters, Andrew El-Kadi, Samier Merchant 等 (25 人)
abstract: State-of-the-art AI weather models have shown impressive medium-range forecast skill and computational efficiency, but suffer two key shortcomings: their forecasts have lower spatial and temporal resolution than the best physics-based models and they are exclusively initialized with and trained on analysis data. As a result, they cannot directly make use of observations, and any biases in the analysis are inherited by the forecast. WeatherNext 3 addresses these shortcomings and establishes a new state-of-the-art for probabilistic medium-range forecasting skill. First, WeatherNext 3 generates new forecasts every hour (rather than every 6 hours like traditional global models) by ingesting low-latency geostationary satellite data. Second, WeatherNext 3's temporal and spatial resolution are on par with physics-based global models, with hourly time steps and 0.1 degree resolution for single-level variables, including solar radiation and cloud cover. Third, WeatherNext 3 moves beyond traditional analysis variables by learning to predict satellite-derived precipitation estimates, as well as tropical cyclone and station observations. Modelling sparse station data allows WeatherNext 3 to make 2m temperature and dewpoint predictions at any location and time, conditioned on local geographical features, with substantially lower error than competing global models, even when evaluated against unseen stations. Together, WeatherNext 3's capabilities move operational AI-based weather forecasting beyond emulating the traditionally distinct stages of data assimilation, forecasting and post-processing, which helps to further push the frontier of performance and granularity for global weather prediction.
summary_zh: 当前最先进的AI气象模型已经展现出优异的中期预报能力和计算效率，但仍存在两个核心缺陷：其预报的时空分辨率低于最优的物理驱动气象模型，且仅使用分析数据进行初始化和训练，无法直接利用观测数据，分析过程中存在的任何偏差都会被预报结果继承。WeatherNext 3针对上述缺陷进行优化，将概率中期预报的性能提升到新的业界标杆水平：第一，WeatherNext 3通过接入低延迟静止卫星数据，实现每小时生成一次新预报，而传统全球气象模型的更新频率为每6小时一次；第二，WeatherNext 3的时空分辨率与物理驱动全球气象模型相当，时间步长为1小时，太阳辐射、云量等单层变量的空间分辨率达到0.1度；第三，WeatherNext 3突破了传统分析变量的限制，可学习预测卫星反演降水估计值、热带气旋观测数据和地面站点观测数据。对稀疏站点数据的建模能力让WeatherNext 3可以结合局地地理特征，在任意位置和时间生成2米气温和露点预测，即使在从未见过的站点上评估，其预测误差也远低于其他同类全球气象模型。上述能力共同推动业务化AI气象预报突破传统数据同化、预报、后处理相互独立的阶段，进一步拓展了全球气象预报的性能和精细度边界。

title: Coupled Scaling: A Representational Accessibility Framework for Neural Scaling Laws
title_zh: 耦合缩放：面向神经缩放定律的表征可及性框架
authors: Jie Wang
abstract: Existing theories derive neural scaling from data geometry or a specified data-model spectrum, but systems trained on the same data can scale differently when architecture or optimization changes the representations they can efficiently reach. We introduce Coupled Scaling, a task-conditioned framework in which finite-budget scaling depends on the relation between task structure and the geometry accessible to an architecture-optimization system. In a solvable mode-truncation model, loss separates into target energy outside architectural support and an unresolved supported tail. For an arbitrary priority order, the residual lies between the best-N supported tail and the tail beyond the largest completed high-value prefix. If the cumulative-tail and coverage log-rates are $\gamma_{A,T}$ and $\rho_{A,O,T}$, the residual exponent lies in $[\rho_{A,O,T}\gamma_{A,T},\gamma_{A,T}]$. Under bounded off-prefix gain, the completed prefix is rate-determining and $\alpha_{A,O,T}=\rho_{A,O,T}\gamma_{A,T}$; for $a_{A,T,j}\asymp j^{-b_{A,T}}$, this gives $\alpha_{A,O,T}=\rho_{A,O,T}(b_{A,T}-1)$. A fixed-kernel specialization derives the training-time exponent from the near-zero tail of a task-weighted spectral measure defined independently of the loss fit. The framework separates architectural support from finite-budget acquisition and motivates two tests: static task-relevant geometry should track loss at a common budget, while multiscale geometry should track coupling-specific exponent ordering, including reversal across contrasting tasks. An audit of released emergence trajectories identifies the controls needed for a direct factorial test that measures geometry separately from the scaling fit.
summary_zh: 现有理论从数据几何或指定的数据-模型谱出发推导神经缩放规律，但在同一数据集上训练的系统，当架构或优化策略改变了其可高效到达的表征空间时，缩放行为会出现明显差异。本文提出耦合缩放（Coupled Scaling）这一任务条件框架，该框架下有限预算下的缩放行为由任务结构与架构-优化系统可及几何空间的关系共同决定。在可解的模式截断模型中，损失可分离为架构支持范围外的目标能量项和未被完全解析的支持尾项。对于任意优先级排序，残差介于最优N项支持尾和最大已完成高价值前缀之外的尾项之间。若累积尾项覆盖率对数率为$\gamma_{A,T}$，覆盖对数率为$\rho_{A,O,T}$，则残差指数落在区间$[\rho_{A,O,T}\gamma_{A,T},\gamma_{A,T}]$内。当非前缀增益有界时，已完成前缀项成为速率决定项，此时$\alpha_{A,O,T}=\rho_{A,O,T}\gamma_{A,T}$；若$a_{A,T,j}\asymp j^{-b_{A,T}}$，则可推导出$\alpha_{A,O,T}=\rho_{A,O,T}(b_{A,T}-1)$。固定核特化场景下，训练时间指数可从独立于损失拟合定义的任务加权谱测度的近零尾项推导得到。该框架将架构支持能力与有限预算下的特征获取过程分离，提出两类验证思路：静态任务相关几何特征应在同一预算下与损失变化保持一致，多尺度几何特征应与耦合相关的指数排序（包括不同任务间的指数反转现象）保持一致。对已公开的涌现轨迹的审计明确了开展直接因子检验所需的控制条件，该检验可将几何特征与缩放拟合效果分离开来进行独立测量。

title: EPIC: Explicit Posterior Item Conditioning for Semantic ID Diffusion Recommendation
title_zh: EPIC：面向语义ID扩散推荐的显式后验物品条件化方法
authors: Tuan-Binh Tran, Thanh Tam Nguyen, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen, Dung D. Le, Tung Kieu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Semantic ID (SID) generative recommendation predicts the next item by generating a short tuple of discrete tokens. Recent masked-diffusion methods improve this process through bidirectional context and flexible decoding, yet recommendation ultimately requires selecting among complete catalog items. At each denoising step, a partial SID can correspond to multiple feasible items, while existing methods primarily reason through position-wise token predictions. We propose Explicit Posterior Item Conditioning (EPIC), which introduces explicit item-level competition into SID denoising. EPIC constructs a personalized posterior over feasible candidate items using the current generation context and the user's recent interactions, then projects this distribution back to unresolved SID positions to guide subsequent token decisions. The pretrained backbone remains frozen and requires no additional decoder forward pass. Experiments on four Amazon benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, while diagnostic analyses indicate that the gains primarily arise from personalized transition evidence that preserves promising item hypotheses during denoising.
summary_zh: 语义ID（Semantic ID, SID）生成式推荐通过生成离散令牌的短元组来预测下一个交互物品。近期的掩码扩散方法利用双向上下文和灵活解码机制优化了该生成过程，但推荐任务最终仍需要从完整的物品目录中选择目标物品。在每一步去噪过程中，部分生成的SID可能对应多个可行物品，而现有方法主要基于逐位置的令牌预测进行推理。本文提出显式后验物品条件化方法（Explicit Posterior Item Conditioning, EPIC），在SID去噪过程中引入显式的物品层面竞争机制：EPIC利用当前生成上下文和用户近期交互，构建所有可行候选物品上的个性化后验分布，再将该分布投影回尚未生成的SID位置，指导后续的令牌决策。该方法不需要修改预训练骨干网络，骨干网络保持冻结状态，也不需要额外的解码器前向传播。在4个亚马逊基准数据集上开展的实验表明，EPIC相比当前最优基线实现了一致的性能提升，诊断分析显示性能增益主要来自个性化转移证据，该机制可以在去噪过程中保留有潜力的物品假设。

title: An Adversarial Zero-Shot Learning Approach for Anomaly Detection in Multivariate IoT Traffic Data
title_zh: 面向多元物联网流量数据异常检测的对抗零样本学习方法
authors: Mahshid Rezakhani, Tolunay Seyfi, Fatemeh Afghah
abstract: Anomaly detection in Internet of Things (IoT) networks presents unique challenges due to the diversity of devices, lack of labeled data, and domain variability across environments. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection that leverages adversarial learning and contrastive loss within a sequence-based Variational Autoencoder (VAE) architecture. Our method enables zero-shot domain adaptation by jointly optimizing domain-invariant latent representations and semantically structured embedding spaces, without requiring labeled data or raw feature transfer. To address the heterogeneity of IoT deployments, we introduce encoder and decoder adaptor layers that align feature distributions across domains while preserving contextual semantics. Additionally, we propose a destination-based segmentation strategy to better model real-world communication structures in IoT traffic. Our framework is comprehensively evaluated on six distinct datasets spanning industrial, enterprise, general-purpose, smart home, and military automation domains across 44 transfer scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization in several cross-domain settings and competitive performance against a contrastive domain-adaptation baseline under realistic, heterogeneous, and privacy-constrained IoT conditions.
summary_zh: 物联网（Internet of Things, IoT）网络中的设备多样性、标注数据稀缺性、跨环境域差异性给异常检测任务带来了独特挑战。本文提出一种面向多元时序异常检测的全新框架，在基于序列的变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoder, VAE）架构中融合对抗学习和对比损失。该方法通过联合优化域不变隐表征和语义结构化嵌入空间，在不需要标注数据或原始特征迁移的前提下实现零样本域自适应。为解决物联网部署场景的异质性问题，本文引入编码器和解码器适配层，在保留上下文语义的同时对齐跨域特征分布。此外，本文提出基于目标的分段策略，更好地建模物联网流量中的真实通信结构。我们在覆盖工业、企业、通用场景、智能家居、军事自动化领域的6个不同数据集上，针对44种迁移场景对该框架进行全面评估。实验结果表明，该方法在多个跨域场景下展现出极强的零样本泛化能力，在真实、异构、隐私受限的物联网场景下性能优于对比域自适应基线方法。

title: Restricted Eigenvalues Beyond Gaussian Width: Threshold Occupancy under Heavy Tails
title_zh: 超越高斯宽度的受限特征值：重尾分布下的阈值占用问题
authors: Shi Fu, Huibo Xu, Qixin Zhang, Dacheng Tao
abstract: Restricted eigenvalue (RE) bounds govern stable recovery by norm-regularized estimators. For isotropic sub-Gaussian measurements, the benchmark sample size is $1+w(A)^2$, where $w(A)$ is the Gaussian width of the normalized descent cone. The COLT 2015 open-problem note (Banerjee et al., 2015) asked whether the same law follows for heavy-tailed designs from a uniform small-ball condition alone. We give an explicit and systematic negative answer to the general question as formulated there: the proposed law fails in its full dimension-free, arbitrary-set form, and the missing obstruction is simultaneous threshold occupancy. A constant-width polyhedral descent cone with fixed small-ball constants has zero empirical RE on every sample path up to half the ambient dimension. More generally, every finite range space admits exact threshold encoding in an arbitrarily narrow spherical cap and a lift to a full polyhedral descent-cone section. For every fixed threshold VC dimension $d$, as $\beta\downarrow0$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity is $\Theta(\beta^{-1}[d\log(1/\beta)+\log(1/\delta)])$. The separation persists under exact isotropy and all finite moments: on the same constant-width cone, Gaussian measurements succeed with $O(1+\log(1/\delta))$ samples, whereas an isotropic heavy-tailed design fails pathwise for $n\lesssim\sqrt{p/\log p}$. Gaussian smoothing yields an everywhere-positive $C^\infty$ density while retaining arbitrarily poor RE. Under isotropy, a distribution-free fallback governed by affine dimension times squared enclosing radius is sharp on this family.
summary_zh: 受限特征值（Restricted Eigenvalue, RE）界是范数正则化估计器实现稳定恢复的核心条件。对于各向同性次高斯测量，基准样本量为$1+w(A)^2$，其中$w(A)$是归一化下降锥的高斯宽度。COLT 2015的开放问题笔记（Banerjee et al., 2015）提出，仅基于均匀小球条件，重尾设计是否也满足相同的样本量规律？本文对该问题给出了明确且系统的否定答案：该规律在完全无维度约束、任意集合的形式下不成立，缺失的核心障碍是同步阈值占用问题。具有固定宽度、固定小球常数的多面下降锥，在环境维度一半以内的所有样本路径上的经验RE值都为0。更一般地，所有有限范围空间都可以在任意窄的球帽中实现精确阈值编码，并可提升为完整的多面下降锥截面。对于任意固定的阈值VC维数$d$，当$\beta\downarrow0$时，最坏情况下的精确样本复杂度为$\Theta(\beta^{-1}[d\log(1/\beta)+\log(1/\delta)])$。该差异在严格各向同性和所有有限矩条件下仍然存在：在同一恒定宽度锥上，高斯测量仅需$O(1+\log(1/\delta))$个样本即可成功，而各向同性重尾设计在$n\lesssim\sqrt{p/\log p}$时所有路径都会失败。高斯平滑可以生成处处为正的$C^\infty$密度，但仍可以保留极差的RE性质。在各向同性条件下，由仿射维度乘以包围半径平方决定的无分布下界在该类场景下是紧的。

title: Towards a Statistical Understanding of Mixture-of-Experts
title_zh: 面向混合专家模型（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）的统计特性理解
authors: Siyuan He, Bokai Yang, Jie Hu, Ziwen Gao, Yuhong Yang
abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures increase model capacity by combining a collection of expert predictors through input-dependent routing, while often activating only a small subset of experts for each input. Despite their growing importance in modern large-scale models, the statistical roles of their design choices, especially routing, sparse activation, and shared experts, remain only partially understood, as existing theory has largely focused on parametric or correctly specified MoE models. In this paper, we view MoE as a form of localized aggregation and show how this localization reshapes the approximation-estimation-computation tradeoff. We derive oracle risk bounds for learning dense and sparse routing with evolving experts, separating approximation, expert-learning, and router-estimation errors, and characterize how sparse Top-K routing can retain the benefits of localized aggregation while controlling per-input computation. We also interpret gating through the geometry of input space, relating routing performance to regions of local expert advantage, and show how shared experts, as adopted in architectures such as DeepSeekMoE, can extract common predictive structure so that routed experts focus on residual local variation. Together, these results provide a unified statistical framework for understanding MoE through input-dependent expert aggregation, in which expert specialization and computational tradeoffs are governed by local predictive structure.
summary_zh: 混合专家（MoE）架构通过基于输入的路由机制组合多个专家预测器来提升模型容量，对于每个输入通常仅激活一小部分专家。尽管这类模型在现代大规模模型中的重要性不断提升，但其设计选择（尤其是路由机制、稀疏激活和共享专家）的统计作用仍仅得到部分阐释，现有理论大多聚焦于参数化或设定正确的MoE模型。本文将MoE视为一种局部聚合形式，阐明这种局部化如何重塑近似-估计-计算权衡关系。本文推导了专家动态演化场景下稠密路由与稀疏路由的神谕风险边界，将近似误差、专家学习误差和路由估计误差分离开来，刻画了稀疏Top-K路由如何在控制单输入计算量的同时保留局部聚合的优势。本文还通过输入空间的几何特性对门控机制进行解读，将路由性能与局部专家优势区域相关联，阐明DeepSeekMoE等架构中采用的共享专家如何提取通用预测结构，使路由专家能够聚焦于残差局部变异。上述成果共同构建了基于输入依赖型专家聚合的统一统计框架，用于理解MoE的运行机制，其中专家专业化特性与计算权衡关系均由局部预测结构决定。

title: Spectral characteristics of autoencoder parameters as a vector representation of data
title_zh: 作为数据向量表示的自编码器参数谱特征
authors: Maria Nikitina, Anton Bishuk, Oleg Bakhteev
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between the parameters of autoencoder models and the statistical properties of the data on which they are trained. Autoencoders are defined as models with an encoder-decoder architecture, trained to reconstruct input data through a compressed latent representation. It is proposed that the model parameters can be viewed as a dense vector representation of the corresponding sample. To test this hypothesis, a theoretical and experimental study is conducted in which a vector representation is formed based on the spectral characteristics of the autoencoder parameter matrices. Theoretical analysis shows that the singular values of the model parameter matrices are related to the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix of the training data, ensuring the transfer of information between the data space and the parameter space. Experimental results on the CIFAR-10 and FashionMNIST datasets confirm that the resulting vector representations allow for a high degree of accuracy in distinguishing between models trained on different data subsets, without resorting to complex vector generation algorithms or using the original samples. These results suggest that the parameters of trained autoencoders can be viewed as sample representations.
summary_zh: 本文研究了自编码器模型参数与其训练数据统计特性之间的关联。自编码器是一类具备编码器-解码器架构的模型，通过压缩后的隐层表示实现输入数据的重建。本文提出可将模型参数视为对应样本的稠密向量表示。为验证该假设，本文开展了理论与实验结合的研究，基于自编码器参数矩阵的谱特征构建向量表示。理论分析表明，模型参数矩阵的奇异值与训练数据协方差矩阵的特征值相关，保障了数据空间与参数空间之间的信息传递。在CIFAR-10和FashionMNIST数据集上的实验结果证实，生成的向量表示可高精度区分在不同数据子集上训练的模型，无需依赖复杂的向量生成算法或使用原始样本。上述结果表明，训练完成的自编码器参数可被视为样本的有效表示。

title: Mind the Gap: Robustness Risks in PII Detection Systems
title_zh: 注意差距：个人可识别信息（Personally Identifiable Information, PII）检测系统的鲁棒性风险
authors: Adeel Zafar, Slawomir Nowaczyk
abstract: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection is a foundational component of data protection infrastructure where missed entities constitute direct privacy and security risks. Although modern PII systems report strong performance on standard benchmarks, we show that these evaluations mask substantial robustness failures under realistic distribution shifts encountered in deployment. Rather than comparing state-of-the-art accuracy, we study how different PII detection paradigms fail under noisy, unstructured, and informal inputs. We construct a stress test benchmark spanning seven categories of natural distribution shift and evaluate representative systems from three widely deployed architectural families: encoder-based NER (SpaCy), rule-based hybrid detection (Presidio), and generative LLM extraction (Qwen2.5-3B).All three exhibit significant degradation on out-of-distribution inputs, but with distinct and complementary failure modes. Encoder models primarily fail on unseen surface forms and boundary detection, rule-based systems fail on non-standard formats, and LLMs exhibit entity-type confusion and generation instability. These results show that aggregate benchmark scores obscure deployment-critical weaknesses and that no single architecture is uniformly reliable across PII categories. Motivated by these findings, we propose a hybrid detection pipeline with a QA-driven feedback loop for iterative risk mitigation, and release our benchmark to support OOD-aware evaluation of PII systems.
summary_zh: 个人可识别信息（PII）检测是数据保护基础设施的核心组成部分，漏检实体将直接引发隐私与安全风险。尽管现代PII检测系统在标准基准测试中表现优异，本文证实这类评估掩盖了系统在部署过程中遇到的真实分布偏移场景下存在的大量鲁棒性缺陷。本文未对比各类方法的最优准确率，而是研究不同PII检测范式在含噪、非结构化、非正式输入场景下的失效模式。本文构建了覆盖7类自然分布偏移的压力测试基准，对三类广泛部署的架构家族中的代表性系统开展评估：基于编码器的命名实体识别（SpaCy）、基于规则的混合检测系统（Presidio）、生成式大语言模型提取系统（Qwen2.5-3B）。三类系统在分布外输入场景下均出现性能大幅下降，但失效模式各不相同且具有互补性：编码器模型主要在未见过的表层形式和边界检测任务上失效，基于规则的系统在非标准格式场景下失效，大语言模型则存在实体类型混淆和生成不稳定问题。上述结果表明，聚合基准分数掩盖了对部署至关重要的缺陷，没有任何单一架构能够在所有PII类别下始终保持可靠。基于上述发现，本文提出了带有QA驱动反馈回路的混合检测流水线，用于迭代缓解风险，并开源了相关基准以支持面向分布外场景的PII系统评估。

title: A Two-Stage Forecasting System for CPU Workload Prediction in Private Clouds
title_zh: 面向私有云CPU工作负载预测的两阶段预测系统
authors: Ashir Javeed, Anton Borg, Håkan Grahn, Lars Lundberg, Dhyey Patel 等 (6 人)
abstract: Accurate cloud resource forecasting is essential for proactive resource provisioning, maintaining Quality of Service (QoS), and reducing operational costs in dynamic cloud environments. The existing forecasting approaches predominantly estimate future CPU workload directly from historical resource traces, which often overlook the relationship between customer service demand and subsequent resource consumption. This study proposes a two-stage integrated forecasting model that explicitly models this dependency by first forecasting customer service requests, expressed as Transactions Per Second (TPS), and subsequently estimating future CPU workload from the TPS forecast. Both the forecasting component and resource prediction component employed the XGBoost model within a cascaded learning architecture, complemented by adaptive online retraining using an expanding-window strategy to address concept drift in continuously evolving cloud workloads. The proposed work was evaluated using real-world traces collected from a private cloud environment comprising ten applications. Experimental results demonstrate robust forecasting performance by achieving Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE) below $7\%$ for most applications, with the best-performing application achieving an MAE of $0.7372$, RMSE of $1.1866$, SMAPE of $3.57\%$, and an R2 of $0.9185$. Horizon-wise drift analysis confirmed stable recursive forecasting behavior with controlled error accumulation across a 60-step prediction horizon. Compared with the conventional direct CPU forecasting method, the proposed two-stage integrated model gives improved forecasting robustness, computational efficiency, and interpretability, making it well-suited for proactive resource management and intelligent auto-scaling in cloud computing environments.
summary_zh: 精准的云资源预测是动态云环境下实现主动资源供给、保障服务质量（Quality of Service, QoS）、降低运营成本的核心基础。现有预测方法大多直接从历史资源轨迹估算未来CPU工作负载，往往忽略了客户服务需求与后续资源消耗之间的关联。本研究提出一种两阶段集成预测模型，对上述依赖关系进行显式建模：首先预测以每秒事务数（Transactions Per Second, TPS）表征的客户服务请求量，再基于TPS预测结果估算未来CPU工作负载。预测组件和资源预测组件均采用级联学习架构下的XGBoost模型，搭配基于扩展窗口策略的自适应在线重训练机制，解决持续演化云工作负载中的概念漂移问题。本文基于包含10个应用的真实私有云环境采集的轨迹数据对所提方法进行评估，实验结果显示其预测性能鲁棒性优异，多数应用的对称平均绝对百分比误差（Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error, SMAPE）低于7%，表现最优的应用实现了0.7372的平均绝对误差（MAE）、1.1866的均方根误差（RMSE）、3.57%的SMAPE和0.9185的决定系数R2。基于预测时域的漂移分析证实，该方法在60步预测时域内递归预测行为稳定，误差累积可控。与传统直接CPU预测方法相比，所提两阶段集成模型的预测鲁棒性、计算效率和可解释性均得到提升，非常适用于云计算环境下的主动资源管理和智能自动扩缩容场景。

title: Beyond Straightness: Non-Crossing Flow Matching via Quantile AlignTree Coupling
title_zh: 超越直线性：基于分位数对齐树耦合的非交叉流匹配
authors: Junyi Lin, Mengyu Li, Jingxuan Hu, Kejun He, Cheng Meng
abstract: The performance of Flow Matching largely depends on the quality of the coupling between the source and target distributions. However, independent coupling often leads to path crossings and local velocity ambiguity, while OT-based couplings typically incur high construction costs. To address this challenge, we propose Quantile AlignTree Flow Matching (QAT-FM), an efficient structured coupling strategy that constructs a hierarchical coupling between a Gaussian prior and the target data distribution via a quantile-aligned tree structure. QAT-FM constructs the coupling in $\mathcal{O}(Nd\log N)$ time and supports per-pair source sampling with $\mathcal{O}(d)$ complexity, enabling scalable training for large-scale high-dimensional generative tasks. Theoretically, we prove that the QAT coupling satisfies marginal consistency, induces non-crossing linear interpolation paths, and consistently improves path separation at intermediate times compared with independent coupling, thereby alleviating local velocity ambiguity. QAT-FM further extends naturally to conditional generation, enabling structured conditional coupling while preserving global Gaussian alignment. Experiments across diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that QAT-FM achieves competitive generative performance while substantially reducing coupling construction cost.
summary_zh: 流匹配（Flow Matching）的性能很大程度上取决于源分布与目标分布之间的耦合质量。然而独立耦合通常会导致路径交叉和局部速度歧义，基于最优传输（OT）的耦合则往往构建成本极高。为解决该问题，本文提出分位数对齐树流匹配（Quantile AlignTree Flow Matching, QAT-FM），这是一种高效的结构化耦合策略，通过分位数对齐的树结构在高斯先验与目标数据分布之间构建层级耦合。QAT-FM构建耦合的时间复杂度为O(Nd log N)，支持成对源采样的复杂度为O(d)，可支撑大规模高维生成任务的可扩展训练。理论层面，本文证明QAT耦合满足边缘一致性，生成非交叉线性插值路径，与独立耦合相比可持续提升中间时刻的路径分离度，从而缓解局部速度歧义。QAT-FM可自然扩展至条件生成场景，在保留全局高斯对齐的同时实现结构化条件耦合。在多类基准数据集上的实验表明，QAT-FM在实现极具竞争力的生成性能的同时，大幅降低了耦合构建成本。

title: Guide, Not Bind: Why Defeasible Priors Fail in Augmented Lagrangian Causal Discovery
title_zh: 引导而非约束：可废止先验在增广拉格朗日因果发现中失效的原因
authors: Sairam Sundararaman, Sara Girdhar, Manit Narasimha Murthy, Samrudh N, Bhaskarjyoti Das
abstract: Differentiable causal discovery methods increasingly encode expert priors as forbidden-edge constraints enforced by an Augmented Lagrangian (ALM) penalty, on the assumption that a data-adaptive relaxation mechanism will discount and eventually override a rule the data consistently contradicts. We show this design, which we call \emph{guide, not bind}, fails for two independent, precisely characterized reasons, and that directly repairing both restores it only partially. First, sequential penalty-ramping ALM suppresses a wrongly-forbidden true edge before any counterfactual check can detect it: we give three necessary conditions any adaptive relaxation must satisfy to avoid this (Proposition~\ref{prop:conditions}), prove that DADU---the natural relaxation rule this paper introduces as the object of study---violates all three (Corollary~\ref{cor:dadu_failure}), and confirm the failure across 3{,}072 training runs spanning graphs from 4 to 32 nodes, where a single wrong prior suppresses a true edge in 87--97\% of trials under DADU. Second, and independent of any fix to the mechanism, we prove in closed form that the standard correlation-matching objective ties a true edge and its reverse to an identical cost of exactly $2r^2$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:tie}), not because the underlying equal-variance model is unidentifiable, but because normalizing to correlation discards exactly the variance information that would make it identifiable; covariance matching instead separates the two directions by a provable margin of at least $w_0^4$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:separation}).
summary_zh: 可微因果发现方法越来越多地将专家先验编码为禁止边约束，通过增广拉格朗日方法（Augmented Lagrangian, ALM）的惩罚项强制执行，其核心假设是数据自适应松弛机制会对与数据持续矛盾的规则进行折减，最终覆盖该规则。本文证实这种被称为“引导而非约束”的设计会因两个相互独立、可精确刻画的原因失效，直接修复这两个问题也仅能部分恢复其性能。第一，序列惩罚递增的增广拉格朗日机制会在任何反事实检查检测到错误之前，就抑制被错误禁止的真实边：本文给出了自适应松弛机制必须满足的三个必要条件以避免该问题（命题1），证明本文作为研究对象提出的自然松弛规则DADU违反全部三个条件（推论1），并在覆盖4到32节点图的3072次训练运行中验证了该失效现象：在DADU机制下，单个错误先验会在87%~97%的试验中抑制真实边。第二，与机制层面的任何修复无关，本文通过闭式证明发现，标准的相关匹配目标会将真实边及其反向边绑定到完全相等的2r²代价上（引理1），这并非因为底层等方差模型不可识别，而是因为归一化到相关系数的操作恰好丢弃了可实现可识别性的方差信息；采用协方差匹配则可证明两个方向的代价差距至少为w₀⁴，实现二者的分离（引理2）。

title: Inferred Generative-Process Diversity Predicts Correlated Failure Across Language Models
title_zh: 推断得到的生成过程多样性可预测大语言模型间的关联失效
authors: Ross Tieman, Evan Markou
abstract: Diversity is a widely observed factor in the resilient function of collective systems, yet the type of diversity that matters depends on the properties and failure modes of the system. This distinction is important for systems composed of multiple language models. Different models may be treated as independent components even when their behaviour and failures remain strongly correlated. Assessments of language-model populations using semantic similarity demonstrate limited semantic diversity, but this captures only differences in the meaning of observed outputs. We argue that a more fundamental notion of model diversity is generative-process diversity, the differences between processes capable of generating the observed outputs. Drawing from Algorithmic Information Theory, we use Normalised Compression Distance between raw model outputs, residualised against a permutation control, as a measure of inferred generative-process diversity. Across 38 language models, this measure identifies population structure missed by semantic similarity and predicts cross-task variation in chance-corrected correlated failure among model pairs across ten disjoint benchmark families, beyond semantic similarity and model-pair capability. The cross-benchmark partial rank association is $-0.216$ with a 95% interval of $[-0.309,-0.122]$, and the estimate is negative on all ten benchmarks. These results indicate that increased generative-process diversity is associated with reduced correlated failure in model pairs that is not attributable to semantic similarity or capability. Inferred generative-process diversity offers a novel and practical approach for investigating diversity of multi-model systems in safety-relevant contexts.
summary_zh: 多样性是集体系统实现弹性运行的广泛观测要素，但真正起作用的多样性类型取决于系统的属性和失效模式。对于由多个大语言模型组成的系统而言，这一区分尤为重要：不同模型即便行为和失效模式高度相关，仍可能被视为独立组件。基于语义相似度的大语言模型群体评估显示其语义多样性有限，但这类指标仅能捕捉观测输出的语义差异。本文提出，模型多样性更基础的定义是生成过程多样性，即能够生成观测输出的底层过程之间的差异。基于算法信息论，本文使用经过置换控制残差处理的原始模型输出之间的归一化压缩距离，作为推断得到的生成过程多样性的度量指标。在38个大语言模型上的实验显示，该指标可识别语义相似度无法捕捉的群体结构，在10个独立基准家族中预测模型对之间经机会校正的关联失效跨任务变异的能力优于语义相似度和模型对能力。跨基准的偏秩关联为-0.216，95%置信区间为[-0.309,-0.122]，且所有10个基准上的估计值均为负。上述结果表明，生成过程多样性的提升与模型对关联失效的降低相关，该效应无法被语义相似度或能力差异解释。推断得到的生成过程多样性为安全相关场景下的多模型系统多样性研究提供了一种新颖实用的方法。

title: Computing stable configurations of confined smectic liquid crystals with a deep variational framework
title_zh: 基于深度变分框架计算受限近晶液晶的稳定构型
authors: Yuchen Xie, Baoming Shi, Yucen Han, Lei Zhang
abstract: Smectic liquid crystals are layered liquid-crystalline phases characterized by orientational order and periodic density modulation. Although their structures can be modeled using continuum theories, computing stable configurations remains challenging in complex geometries, particularly when the high-frequency density modulations associated with smectic layering should be resolved. We propose a deep variational framework (DVF) for computing these configurations within the modified Landau--de Gennes model, in which the coupled orientational and positional order parameters are represented on a regular reference domain while physical confinement is incorporated through coordinate mappings. A warmup penalty mitigates the spectral bias of neural networks toward smooth, nonlayered fields, enabling robust recovery of oscillatory smectic states. Comparisons with a neural-network baseline and finite-difference relaxation demonstrate the essential role of this penalty and the numerical stability of the resulting layered states. The DVF reproduces experimentally established smectic-A defect structures and layer morphologies across diverse confinement geometries and further predicts a chevron-like smectic-C state in a tangent-anchored sphere. Together, these results demonstrate the applicability of the DVF to computing stable smectic configurations across experimentally relevant confinement geometries and anchoring conditions.
summary_zh: 近晶液晶是一类层状液晶相，具备取向序和周期性密度调制特性。尽管可通过连续介质理论对其结构建模，但在复杂几何构型下计算稳定构型仍极具挑战性，尤其是需要解析近晶层相关的高频密度调制的场景。本文提出一种深度变分框架（DVF），用于在修正朗道-德热纳（Landau--de Gennes）模型下计算上述构型：耦合的取向序参数和位置序参数在规则参考域上表示，物理约束通过坐标映射引入。本文采用预热惩罚项缓解神经网络对平滑非层状场的谱偏置，实现对振荡近晶态的鲁棒恢复。与神经网络基线方法和有限差分松弛方法的对比实验证实了该惩罚项的核心作用，以及生成的层状态的数值稳定性。该深度变分框架可在多种约束几何下复现实验已验证的近晶A相缺陷结构和层形态，还可预测切向锚定球体中类 Chevron 近晶C相的存在。上述结果共同证实，该深度变分框架可在各类实验相关的约束几何和锚定条件下，用于计算近晶液晶的稳定构型。

title: TIGPO: Temporal Instance-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_zh: TIGPO：面向长程大语言模型智能体的时序实例图策略优化
authors: Jinwei Gan
abstract: Graph-based policy optimization improves credit assignment for long-horizon LLM agents by organizing rollout trajectories into state-transition graphs. However, existing methods construct graphs independently within each policy update, discarding transitions discovered by earlier policies and limiting advantage estimation to small, batch-local rollout groups. We propose \emph{Temporal Instance-Graph Policy Optimization} (TIGPO), which extends graph-based credit assignment across policy updates. TIGPO maintains a persistent transition graph for each task, allowing valid transitions discovered by different policy versions to jointly determine credit for current rollouts. To actively reconnect current exploration with historical experience, TIGPO allocates a fixed rollout budget between Exploration slots for ordinary task sampling and Revisit slots for delayed reattempts of previously explored tasks. For each revisit, TIGPO pairs the current rollout group with its corresponding earlier Exploration group to construct a cross-temporal reference. The enlarged reference is designed to stabilize relative advantage estimation under small rollout groups, while comparison on the same task directly captures policy improvement across training stages. Historical transitions and scores serve only as structural and detached statistical references and are never replayed in the policy loss. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that TIGPO consistently outperforms prior group-based and graph-based policy optimization methods.
summary_zh: 基于图的策略优化方法通过将 rollout 轨迹组织为状态转移图，提升长程大语言模型智能体的信用分配能力。但现有方法在每次策略更新时独立构建图，丢弃了早期策略发现的转移，将优势估计限制在小批量本地 rollout 组内。本文提出时序实例图策略优化（Temporal Instance-Graph Policy Optimization, TIGPO），将基于图的信用分配扩展到跨多次策略更新的场景。TIGPO为每个任务维护一个持久化转移图，使不同策略版本发现的有效转移可共同为当前 rollout 确定信用。为主动将当前探索与历史经验关联，TIGPO在普通任务采样的探索槽位和对先前探索任务进行延迟重试的重访槽位之间分配固定的 rollout 预算。每次重访时，TIGPO将当前 rollout 组与对应的早期探索组配对，构建跨时序参考。扩大后的参考集可在小 rollout 组场景下稳定相对优势估计，同一任务上的对比可直接捕捉训练阶段之间的策略提升。历史转移和分数仅作为独立的结构统计参考，不会在策略损失中重放。在ALFWorld和WebShop环境上的实验表明，TIGPO的性能持续优于此前基于组和基于图的策略优化方法。

title: SurgeGen: A Hybrid Generative Diffusion Framework for Storm Surge Scenario Synthesis
title_zh: SurgeGen：用于风暴潮场景合成的混合生成扩散框架
authors: Shunan Zheng, John J. Hasenbein
abstract: Predicting storm surge induced by landfalling tropical cyclones is crucial for flood mitigation and coastal risk management. Traditionally, physics-based numerical models simulate storm surge by solving the Navier--Stokes equations using numerical methods, but these simulations are computationally expensive. Generative models are promising for storm surge emulation because they can generate diverse realizations rather than producing a single deterministic prediction. However, their use for storm surge emulation remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we leverage diffusion models for storm surge surrogate modeling, combining a baseline prediction stage with conditional generation to provide a more interpretable modeling framework. We develop SurgeGen, a two-stage generative framework for generating storm surge scenarios conditioned on hypothetical storms with parameters defined in a continuous space. First, a baseline model produces a coarse estimate of the storm surge height. This estimate then conditions a diffusion model, which generates refined storm surge scenarios that better capture spatial patterns and variability. We demonstrate that our approach can generate realistic and diverse storm surge scenarios under conditions both within and outside the training distribution.
summary_zh: 预测登陆热带气旋引发的风暴潮是洪水减灾和海岸风险管理的核心基础。传统方法中，基于物理的数值模型通过数值方法求解纳维-斯托克斯（Navier--Stokes）方程模拟风暴潮，但这类模拟的计算成本极高。生成式模型可生成多样化的实现结果而非单一确定性预测，在风暴潮仿真场景中极具应用潜力，但目前其在风暴潮仿真中的应用仍处于探索阶段。本文将扩散模型用于风暴潮替代建模，结合基线预测阶段与条件生成，构建可解释性更强的建模框架。本文开发的SurgeGen是一个两阶段生成框架，可基于参数定义在连续空间中的假想风暴生成对应的风暴潮场景。第一阶段由基线模型生成风暴潮高度的粗略估计，该估计作为条件输入扩散模型，生成可更好捕捉空间模式和变异性的精细化风暴潮场景。实验证实，该方法可在训练分布内和分布外的条件下生成真实且多样化的风暴潮场景。

title: RecurTrace: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Loop-Time Memory
authors: Yuxiang Wang, Kunyu Feng, Yingda Shen, Haoning Xu, Junyu Wang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Repeating a small block of middle layers increases a language model's effective inference depth without adding parameters or generating extra tokens, and recent work shows that this latent recurrence improves reasoning. However, two design choices limit these gains. Each iteration sees only the previous output and cannot directly access earlier computations. Moreover, a fixed loop count wastes depth on easy inputs while leaving hard ones with too little computation. We introduce RecurTrace, which addresses both limitations using the loop's own trajectory. Specifically, Loop Memory Attention lets each looped layer attend to its own states from previous iterations along the loop-time axis, so the model can revisit earlier computations instead of relying on the latest state alone. A halting head then reads the loop state and predicts whether to continue, with supervision from an oracle that identifies when additional depth still reduces loss. In a controlled MathQA comparison on the same looped backbone, RecurTrace achieves 56.9% accuracy with an average of 2.0 loops, exceeding the best fixed loop depth by 2.2 points at matched compute. By comparison, ACT and PonderNet collapse to one loop, and CALM reaches only 54.1% with 5.6 loops, while the stronger LoopUS-Conf and TaH-Mismatch baselines reach 55.3% at 3.2 loops and 55.7% at 2.1 loops. Finally, RecurTrace improves generation accuracy over same-budget fine-tuned baselines at 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, and 8B, with the gain growing with model size from 0.6 to 3.4 points.

title: SimpleDesign: A Joint Model for Protein Sequence and Structure Codesign
authors: Jiarui Lu, Yuyang Wang, Yizhe Zhang, Jiatao Gu, Navdeep Jaitly 等 (7 人)
abstract: Proteins are fundamental to biological processes, with their function determined by the complex interplay between the amino acid sequence and the three-dimensional structure. Developing generative models capable of understanding this intrinsically multi-modal relationship is crucial for fields like drug discovery and protein engineering. Existing models often rely on a multi-stage training process where autoencoders that tokenize data into latent representations are trained in a first stage. Secondly, a generative model is trained on the latent representation of the autoencoder(s), i.e., generative modeling in a latent space. We hypothesize that this multi-stage training is not necessary to obtain performant co-design models and thus present SimpleDesign, an effective multi-modal protein design model trained directly in the data space. SimpleDesign leverages a single-stage end-to-end objective that combines discrete cross-entropy for sequences and a regression objective for structures. In order to effectively model the difference in sequence and structure modalities, we develop a Mixture-of-Transformer architecture that allows modality-specific processing while keeping global self-attention over both modalities. We train SimpleDesign on over 2M sequence-structure pairs achieving strong performance across co-design and unconditional sequence/structure generation benchmarks.

title: Spruce: Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings
authors: Peichun Hua, Yunming Xiao
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has made dense retrieval over large document collections a standard building block. Organizations increasingly outsource vector indexes to untrusted clouds, exposing proprietary corpora and user queries. Cryptographic protection is challenging because each query searches corpus-scale state, causing computation, correlated randomness, and communication to grow with the corpus. At million-document scale, a naive secure implementation takes minutes and about 90 GB of communication per query. Even recent optimized systems require 10--22 seconds.We propose Spruce (Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings), which co-designs representations with the cryptographic protocol. Spruce learns compact binary codes that preserve candidates for full-precision reranking, replacing corpus-wide embedding scoring with efficient Hamming-distance computation under two-server multi-party computation (MPC). A corpus-calibrated fixed-radius protocol avoids multi-round candidate selection while preserving retrieval quality. Spruce also provides private cluster pruning, which trades minor quality loss for substantially less computation, and a one-core owner-operated dealer that removes cloud OT preprocessing bottlenecks. Across four corpora containing 383K--5.42M documents, Spruce preserves the original search quality with median candidate sets of only 382--1,952. At 10 Gbps inter-server bandwidth, full scans take 0.21--2.97 seconds, $4.8$--$6.7\times$ faster than the closest measured prior work. Private pruning takes 0.06--1.09 seconds, achieves $13.1$--$22.9\times$ speedups, and retains $93.9\%$--$97.3\%$ of full-float NDCG. On the largest corpus, pruning and the dealer jointly improve sustained throughput by $31.5\times$ at 1 Gbps per link.

title: Grassmann--Plücker Parametrization of Convolutional Filter Subspaces: Regularity and Closed Embeddings
authors: Hongyu Yuan, Huaiqing Zuo
abstract: We propose a geometric parametrization of the filters in a single convolutional layer: the parameter is no longer an ordered family of filter vectors, but a fixed-dimensional subspace of the filter space. For one-dimensional finite-stride convolution, the filter-to-convolution-operator correspondence gives an injective linear map $\mathcal{C}:\mathcal{K}\to H$.
